name: Andrew Cedergren
text:
I really enjoyed my experiences here. The food is really good, and some of the best that I think you can find in Sioux Falls. The only thing I can fault them for is that the sandwiches do seem a bit expensive for what you get, if they could add something other than a small side of chips though I think it would be well rounded out and I'd see myself going often.

The sandwiches though really are great, and have flavors and combinations that are truly unique and will have you coming back. You can even get any of the sandwiches as a salad which is awesome for those looking to skip out on the bread (which is hard as it's some of the best you can find!) They have some good options as well when it comes to beer, with many rotating taps featuring local and imported craft beers.

One of the unique things I wish more people knew about though was that they offer ramen which is at this time a sorely missed food item in Sioux Falls. Well balanced broth flavoring and thickness, with some quality noodles and a very well cooked pork belly. You just can't go wrong!

resp.text: Awesome! Thanks for the thorough review Andrew!

name: Michele Lund
text: Curried cauliflower is excellent! I'll mos definitely be coming back for this one and glass bottled Dr. Pepper.

resp.text: Thanks!!

Very good! Not too busy,  and the staff is very friendly with helpful suggestions and eager to guide newcomers.  With the gorgeous outdoor seating area and the delicious food, we will definitely be coming here again!

Hi Jason, none of our sandwiches cost $20.

Good lunch spot option if you like to see the weirdos of downtown walking around.

text: The beer selection is fantastic and takes pride in being local. The menu is very diversified and offers something for everyone. I had the Moroccan chicken salad and it was delicious. text: Im not trying to be super critical. We had the dirty fries, a couple Ingredients I could not identify, the crinkle cut fries didn't hold up to the gravy, there were raw items, cooked ones it wasn't dirty, it was a hot mess! Maybe this set the tone for the burger. I wanted to like it but it was nothing special. Maybe will give it another shot but i had a gift card from someone and i was glad i didnt spend much over it. Really disappointed! Good luck!

name: Duck Shooter
text: Found out about this place due to the Downtown Restaurant Week event.  Stopped in to try it out.  Very cool place.  Staff was super helpful and attentive, food was cooked to order and fresh.  Some reviewers have been unhappy about the food prices.  Yes, the price is a little higher than many people expect in our area and the portion sizes are not huge,  but after traveling as much as I have, I have found high quality food and low cost rarely go together and if you were on the East or West  Coast you wouldn't bat an eye at the prices.  If I had one tiny issue give us more chips please.  Beer selection is pretty good and they had a steady stream of of people on a Sunday afternoon so they must be doing something right. Two sandwiches, two beers, an order of Naughty Fries and tip was right about $50.

resp.text: Thanks DS, appreciate it!

name: Nathanael Anderson

resp.text: Thanks Nathanael!

name: Robert Cray

I recommend the Porkstrami sandwich, great smoke character with the pastrami-like flavor in the meat.  The naughty fries are quite solid too.

Cons: Hand-pattied burger was thick and uneven resulting in several bun-only bites and inconsistent cook. Chips being served with every sandwich without substitution for other sides is an odd choice (I didn't want chips, neither did the group ahead of me). Burger was greasy, bun on brisket was slopped with sauce on the outside making it difficult to manage.

Would try again. New restaurant with promise.

text: The perfect place to take a load off your feet after exploring Mt Rushmore. Its spacious and has good restrooms. I had the Thomas Jefferson recipe vanilla ice cream! Delicious!

name: Patricia Ferdig
text: I was here around mid-afternoon on a weekday and there weren't many people in the dining room. There are several small eateries around the cafeteria you can select from, but there really isn't that much for gluten free folks if you're vegetarian. I ended up getting a vegetarian egg roll dish and splitting it with my kiddo. Gave her the egg roll and I kept the rice & vegetables. The veggies were just boiled/steamed to death broccoli that had almost no crown on it, a few carrot coins, and a couple stems of cauliflower. Not even a crown. Just stems. I paid almost $10 for this plate of disappointment. The cafeteria is beautiful and has wonderful views. Just bring in your own food and have a picnic. You'll enjoy it more and save money.

name: Anthony Miller

I hope someone from corporate reads this and takes action.

name: Rejean Beauchamp
text:
(Translated by Google) To quench the thirst of our motorcycle.

We filled up our bike there on August 31, 2019 around 6:30 pm for $ 6.80 with 2,323 gallons of Plus Blend at $ 2,929. There was also a Subway restaurant on site. We give 3 stars without wishing to cause any harm to the trade because we put only gasoline. If we had a possible option not to punctuate our comments in these cases, that's what we would do. We have 4 pictures to offer you one of the receipt of the transaction at the pump.

Written on October 21, 2019 in Salaberry de Valleyfield, Quebec, Canada.

(Original)
Pour y étancher la soif de notre moto.

Nous y avons fait le plein de notre moto en ce 31 août 2019 vers 18h30 pour un montant de $6.80 avec 2.323 gallons du Plus Blend à $2.929.  Il y avait aussi un restaurant Subway sur place.  Nous donnons 3 étoiles sans vouloir causer aucun préjudice au commerce car nous n’y avons mis seulement que de l’essence. Si nous avions une option possible de ne pas étoiler nos commentaires dans ces cas, c’est ce que nous ferions. Nous avons 4 photos à vous proposer dont une du reçu de la transaction à la pompe.

Avis rédigé le 21 octobre 2019 à Salaberry de Valleyfield, Québec, Canada.

name: Brianna Carothers
text: Another great place to stop and stretch. The Dignity statue is so beautiful. Reading the postings that go with it and learning about what it represents was great for me and my kids. There are little trails you can walk down behind it for an extra stretch. You also get great views of the Missouri River. On premises there is also a visitor center with some historical displays of Lewis and Clark's journey. HOWEVER, the Dignity statue was the best part.

name: richard von Moe
text: Well worth 4 hour round trip..very beautiful sculpture  and I love the message of dignity of the Sioux and it is perfectly standing on Beautiful river valley. It also shimmers in the sun depending on your angle..

name: Jeannine Szostak
text: It was nice to see a place that celebrates our history.

name: Don Den
text: Beautiful statue and tribute. The views are great. Lots of open space to relax. The facility is modern and clean.

name: Marc Crawford
text: Awesome statue!  Amazing view of the river.  A must stop if you are in the area.

name: RobertWin
text: Nice place to visit. Can get a lot of knowledge and also can see very beautiful view of Missouri River and the Great Plains. Must to visit.

name: Stephanie A.
text: The trail was awesome. The statue was beautiful!

name: Melissa Prostrollo
text: Very impressive, beautiful sculpture. Very nice, clean rest area with pet exercise area and walking trails, along with an indoor tourist information center. My little nephew kept telling us he had to go to the bathroom for the rest of our trip just to try to get us to take him back there because he liked the boat in the tourist center, haha. Very nice place. Recommended.

name: Ourperfectlyimperfectlife
text: This statue and rest stop has to be one of the nicest ones in the world. Beautiful views over the Missouri River and so much more, the absolutely amazing Dignity statue, trails and a super nice informative museum (closed for COVID-19). Definitely worth an hour or so of your time.

name: Christi Koch
text: What a beautiful statue!  Nice little museum inside the rest stop.  Beautiful scenery.  The grounds are very well maintained.

name: Scott H
text: Very cool. One of the best drop backs ive ever seen for a statue. Beautiful statue. Check out the museum inside with pretty cool artifacts.

name: Jimmy adams jr
text: Excellent stopping point and view of the Missouri river

name: Nyor Mirror
text: What a great donation to the people of South Dakota. The sculpture in superbly done and is in a very peaceful area with great views of the Missouri river. Several small trails near it to get different views of the Missouri River Bridges and other sights. A rest area with bathrooms, picnic tables and a visitor center. The museum located inside the visitor center was closed due to the pandemic. It is definitely worth a stop.

name: kinser madison
text: Dignity is a beautiful statue with a view that is nothing short of jaw dropping. You haven't discovered the beauty of Chamberlain until you have visited Dignity. I was completely blown away.

name: ThatJacobPowell
text: Cool spot to stop, stretch your legs, and pee. Statue and Views are great. Nicest rest stop I've ever seen.

name: Alex Pellegrineschi
text: Very peaceful and interesting rest stop. The statue is impressive, very well done, but the surrounding area is even more impressive and beautiful. The area overlook the Missouri river, there is a small museum.

name: Jeff
text:
Incredible beauty. Poise, strength, beauty, peace, Dignity.

She renewed my strength. And my commitment to justice, to love, and to courage.

A beautiful statue overlooking the Missouri River and I-90. A breathtaking view that should not be missed. Be sure to stop! It is so much better than Mount Rushmore.

Also has a cool pet exercise area, restrooms, and vending machines. Plenty of parking. And if you’re in the area, you should really check out Tranquil Desires, a nearby store in Chamberlin that really knows all about Dignity.

name: Jennifer V-C
text: Take the time to stop at this beautiful, inspiring tribute to indigenous people. The surrounding area is more than a rest stop and informational center...there are breathtaking views of the Missouri River. And a educational center for all ages.

name: chris moss
text: A great landmark with great meaning..bummer the inside myseum was closed..but cant blame them..dag gum covid. Definately  pull in this rest stop for its convenience and history mixed in..awesome.

name: Bryan Hiller
text: One of a kind stop over looks the Missouri River... Also has a information center with little history exhibits about the area very nice rest area its an easy on and off the hwy..

name: Carter Alfson
text: I loved the scenery. And it was very clean

name: Evie F
text: She is lovely. A sister to the Lady at Ellis. Proud to have her standing over our great prairie.

name: Dee Hanson
text: Beautiful sculpture.

name: Emily Dixon
text: Its was a beautiful day and the Statue was so beautiful!!! I'm so happy they have a statue that represents the native women in such a powerful and positive way. I would recommend everyone to stop by and see it!

name: Linda
text: Stunning tribute to Native American presence in SD. She overlooks the majestic mile wide Missouri River at the rest stop. In side the rest area is an excellent exhibit to Lewis & Clark's journey.

name: METAL BOI
text: Beautiful representative for beautiful people!!

name: Megan Wiedemann
text: It was a very neat place, the information center has a lot of information about Lewis and Clark expedition. It was really cool.

name: Marty billman
text: Interesting that this is at a rest area.  Has a great overlook.  Highly recommend you stop and enjoy

name: Russ
text: Awesome

name: Devanny Doo
text:
This is a great place to stop and stretch your legs. The Dignity sculpture is very tall and beautiful and views of the river are nice too!

They also have a place to run/walk your pets, for those who are traveling with animal companions.

name: Debbie Knee
text: Awesome sight.  Worth the stop right off the interstate!

name: Jeffrey Tate
text: Majestic statue and awe inspiring even though it was cloudy and rainy when we stopped. I'm sure its even more awe inspiring and impressive when the sun hits the statue.

name: Sara Zervos
text:
A DO NOT MISS for certain!
The giant statue of a Sioux woman against the backdrop of a cerulean blue sky on a ridge overlooking miles of Big Sky Country is awesome!!!

name: Rupesh Trivedi
text: Excellent place and view

name: Steven Haag
text: A large statue paying tribute to the Lewis and Clarke expedition at a rest stop. The view is nice.

name: Jacqui Bradley
text: I'm so happy someone decided to pay respect to the Native women of the plains. Beautifully done.

name: Eric Anderson
text: This is a very artistic statue. Nice rest stop with facilities. There is a nice view of the river from this location.

name: TheFire andEarth
text: Very beautiful art work. It has a lot of detail and the view of the river is magnificent from the statue. It is in the rest area just off of the interstate. Very clean and well kept.

name: Jason Burtz
text: Definately worth a stop if you're driving thru. It's really cool when the sun is low in the sky shining through the statues shall. There are trails here to walk and explore with a great view of the Missouri river and valley below.

name: Timothy Bender
text: Nice roomy rest area to stop however it can get very crowded at lunch time. even though it gets crowded there are plenty of picnic tables and grassy areas to spread out on.

name: Ron Rens
text:
A must see the statue is so awesome up
Close a real work of art and a history lesson

name: Lori Corn
text: A must stop if you are going down I90 in the area. A beautiful and clean rest stop that has a larger than life metal sculpture of Dignity. She is very beautiful!

name: john Laro
text: Beautiful statue and nice view...

name: RyBFly SD
text: Stop here for an amazing view and photo opportunity right alongside the rest area

name: Melanie aka Lanieiniowa
text: So beautiful, it was storming with horrible rain but we stopped late at night and ran to the covered shelter. It was beautiful and lit up. Managed to get a picture that looked OK. This is a hidden gem in plain sight you just don't hear a lot about it. Worth the stop, right off the highway, good parking, nice rest stop. You have to get off the highway to see the front of it. Only the back is visible from the highway.

name: Michael Binder
text: The view of the Missouri river is amazing from here. Bring a chair and sit for a while and really take it in.

name: Serena R
text: Beautiful place to stop for a view of the river and to contemplate your journey to or from the West.

name: Zaccaria Dickerson
text: Very historical area. Brings you back in time

name: Gary Burrus
text: Beautiful statue! Also a great place to stretch your legs.

name: Peg Wastell
text: Worth stop and nice paths to stretch legs.

name: Kristi Knudson
text: It's ok, all it is are statues and a tepee, but cool.

name: Dingo Destroyer
text: Beautiful place and I could take my grandmas dog out

name: Brittney Perez
text: The Dignity Statue is located at the rest stop right before entering into Chamberlain, SD. She is gorgeous and embodies the Native American culture and heritage. While viewing Dignity, people can walk the small trail near the statue to take pictures of the Missouri. There is also a visitor center that Dignity was placed by and it has information about Lewis and Clark on their mission out West. The view of Oacoma and Chamberlain from the Dignity statue is also  beautiful.

name: Jo Owens Murray
text: We are touring America and Canada one small town at a time and this is one of the most beautiful statue we've seen. Artbyjo

name: Clayton C
text: Cool statue, great views of the Missouri river

name: Lower48 Traveling
text: Absolutely Beautiful a must see !!!!

name: Linette Batterman
text: This is a beautiful statue! You are able to see the back side of it from I90, but you absolutely Must pull in to see the real beauty! There are other things to see there also and there are nice picnic spots too. It is a very nice rest area

name: Audrey Fergen
text: A rest stop like no other, beautiful statue.

name: Glen Sikorski
text: Beautiful rest area. Almost like stopping at a museum

name: Robert Snow
text:
The rest area and the Dignity Statue are worth visiting in my estimation.
The statute is an excellent symbol of native peoples past and present.
It is very well done and it is physically located in a great location...it's as much a gateway to the "West" as the St. Louis Arch.

name: Chris Ross
text: Refreshing to visit a statue that is fairly new and fairly freakin awesome!

name: MarquittaJayne Schrader
text: Always Breathtaking Anytime of the year

name: Angela Harter
text: This Is a must see it is sooo cool and the scenery is nice

name: Kathleen Gomez
text: Wonderful story. A must stop.

name: J. Gardner
text: Breathtaking, especially with the view.

name: The Lord Runge
text: Is a rest stop with a statue

name: Donna J
text: Very interesting - the rest area also nice - lots of history - well worth the stop

name: Tarah Wuorinen

text: Amazing and beautiful staue of an indigenous Indian woman statue overlooking the Missouri River near Chamberlain, SD.  The stainless steel statue is 50 ft tall, by South Dakota artist Dale Lamphere.  The statue honors the culture of the Lakota and Dakota native Indians who are indigenous to South Dakota.   The statue was erected in 2016 at a site near Interstate 90.  It is situated at the Chamberlain Interstate Welcome Center, located at mile post 264.

name: Tammy McDonald
text:
Checked in at 3:30 and was handed the lunch menu. We asked when dinner was and it would be 4 so we ordered a bottle of wine and asked for the dinner menu (we were going to wait). Once we decided on dinner we asked if we could get an appetizer, yup no problem.

We ordered the Buffalo meatballs but our server, Justin, came back and said the menu we looked at was 6 years old and no longer available! Why in the world were they still around is my question.  That also meant what we chose for dinner wasn't available.

We ended up ordering the buffalo nachos. The buffalo was tasty but the cheese was like canned cheese, not visually appealing for sure. The sour cream was in a packet, so again not visually appealing. It was akin to nachos from Taco Bell, blah!

We decided to have our wine recorked and head to Rapid City for Buffalo ribs.

Justin was extremely apologetic and polite. He said it was the "soft opening" but that didn't dissuade us from leaving.

It was a very disappointing experience, especially since our first choice (Powder House, which their site said they were open but they weren't) was closed. Oh and we were never offered water!

resp.text: I sincerely apologize for the mix up.  We are a seasonal business and we start with a limited menu early in the season and for some reason an old menu was handed out.  I will personally check all the menu's so this does not happen again.  I'm sorry you did not like the buffalo nachos.  It is one of our more popular items but I will talk to the staff and see if we need to make some adjustments.  I hope you will give us another try if you are back in the area.

It truly is disappointing when you've been battling the winds on the Sioux Falls trails, looking forward to a nourishing refueling stop, only to find out you're out of luck. name: Michael Wilder
text:
I am new to town having relocated from the food desert that is Billings, MT and while I have not had access to this type of food in several years in Billings, I am well traveled, including some time in the Middle East courtesy of Uncle Sam's Canoe Club and I know a fair bit about the cuisine. What I found today at Khorasan Kabob House was a humble family making some fairly humble food but with care and love. I had the stuffed grape leaves with meat and they were some of the best I've ever had. Clearly hand rolled and served with a housemade yogurt that I could have easily eaten on its own. They were served with what they call chutney but to me was more like a thin salsa verde. It is apparently made with green tomatoes, cilantro, mint, some type of chili and lime juice. I'm sure there is a bit more to it but that's the main ingredients and it doesn't matter, the stuff is outstanding! I tried it on the dolmas first and then added it to my main course and it just brought already great food to a higher level of flavor. For my main I had the Combo Kabob which was one skewer each of lamb and chicken, both apparently marinated and then grilled. The chicken apparently had a fair amount of turmeric in the marinade as it had an inviting yellow color to it and both skewers were served atop a heaping portion of some really nice basmati rice. It was also served with a salad on the plate consisting of iceberg lettuce and shredded cabbage along with several slices of roma tomatoe and cucumber. The dressing was excellent and reminded me of the Ken's Steakhouse Vidalia Onion Dressing. I also had a terrific piece of garlic naan to go with my dinner and finished it off with a hot cup of milk chai and a slice of bakalava. The milk chai was made from scratch and takes several minutes to prepare so be aware of this when ordering it. The baklava was probably not made in house but regardless, it was a really nice piece with pecans, a nut I've not often seen in it but a welcome respite from the typical almonds, walnuts or pistachios more commonly found in it. It was also fairly heavily spiced with ground cinnamon and was just a really nice accompaniment to the chai and an overall perfect end to an altogether excellent meal.
This will definitely be on the top of my list of favorite restaurants here in Sioux Falls and I can't wait until me next visit when I can try another item on the menu. This is a local business run by a small family and they are putting their heart and soul into this wonderful food. Do yourself a favor and give them a visit. You won't be dissapointed. Oh, and go hungry. They don't skimp on the portions and the prices are pretty well on point for the quality as well as quantity of food. The only reason I didn't give them a full 5 stars is because the lady server wasn't quite as attentive as she should have been and I had to get up and go ask for a couple of things, but on the other hand, I didn't mind being left alone to enjoy the food either so they still deserve very high marks. Great pace. Go see for yourself.

Just a quick reply to the response from the owner...
First, thank you for responding to me personally. I love that you are able to do that. I just want to say again that I had a wonderful meal and will be returning to try several of the many options you have available on your menu. I appreciate you clarifying the baklava question for me. I assumed it was not made in house since you told me the ice cream is not and for that I apologize. I was wondering about it as I was eating it because it was so good and now I know for sure. As for the service, please understand that it was not intended as a criticism but merely an observation. I actually appreciated that I was given the opportunity to eat without interruption but as just a personal preference, I would have actually liked it if you or the gentleman there would have checked with me just once more so that I could have ordered the bread sooner but that's just me. It was in no way a negative on my wonderful experience and I look forward to my next visit.

resp.text:
Michael,

Welcome to Sioux Falls, where even big-city folks rave about the quality and diversity of our restaurant scene. Thanks for your generous and detailed review.

Most of your observations were spot-on, but our baklava is indeed made in house, except for the rare occasion when our home-made stock is depleted and we have to supplement with store-bought. I don't believe the yogurt is made in house, but I agree it is excellent: the only yogurt I have really enjoyed eating plain. I think our specially-prepared  long-grain basmati rice is the best you'll find anywhere.

I'm sorry you felt our service was lacking. That is a continual challenge for a tiny family operation like ours, and we keep trying to do better. I hope you'll be more satisfied on your next visit, when you can try one of more than 50 other items on our menu.

resp.text: Wow, please tell us how we failed you. We're accustomed to 5-star and sometimes 4-star reviews, but to rate a 1 we must have really messed up. We're sorry we failed to satisfy you, but would love to know how. Is there anything we can do to make it right?

If Google's time stamps are to be believed, you posted 50 reviews/ratings in under an hour, roughly divided between 1-star and 5-star ratings. I don't know what the point was, but I doubt you were even in our restaurant. We're accustomed to the 5-star variety and get very concerned when someone leaves us an unexplained 1-star.

If you really did dine at Khorasan Kabob House, please let us know what you found objectionable so we can address it. If not, please withdraw your fraudulent rating.

OOPS! We must have done something terrible. We're used to getting 4- and 5-star reviews. We are very sorry we failed to make your visit wonderful, but would you please tell us what went wrong, so we can fix it, improve it, or eliminate it? name: Rebecca Freidel
text: A little piece of Christmas magic during the Christmas season! During the regular season it's the best place to spend some time in this large park with huge characters right out of storybooks... and it's free! During the Christmas light walks, entry fee is $3. Make sure you ride the merry-go-round. It's worth every bit of $2! You can also ride the train for $2.

name: Tiffany Rupp
text: The metal slides may be hot. The food is all pretty much junk food. The place is run down. but your kids will have a great time. They will run around being surprised by each character they know and love being part of the story. The train is short but a perfect amount of time for toddlers whos minds need constant newness. Also they will enjoy the tunes and dance to them. The bathrooms are cool for the hot days. Employees are very kind.

name: Zoey Alms
text: This place is beyond amazing! So many great memories here growing up just around the corner. The fact that it's free to the public is such a blessing. We especially love it around the holidays with all the Christmas lights up!

text: Such a fun place for kids! I have always loved seeing all the cartoon characters!! It is cool in the summer, but fantastically amazing around Christmas time! They light up everything with lights and play Christmas music. So magical! Definitely bring your camera!

text: Fun place to take the kids. Lots of "stories" represented. Been around for a while but well taken care of and updated with new characters. Kids and adults will love it! Free admission too!!

resp.text: Christina We love hearing that you enjoyed the park and that the staff was great on your visit! We are very proud of the young staff we have working the park this year :)

text: We go to storybook island every year for Halloween. The safe trick or treating was fun as always. There was alot less people this year so the kids actually had space to run around and enjoy the scenery. Staff and volunteers were pleasant as always!

text: Went during the time when the Christmas lights were up. The wait to get in was probably 10-15 minutes as the line was very long. Once we got in the park the lights were very pretty. It's a pretty quick trip through the whole area but it was fun for the cost. Only downside is that the way it is set up forces everyone through the gift shop. I understand it is good for business, but it was very busy in there and frustrating that there wasn't a way to go around to leave.

resp.text: You are actually not forced to go through the gift shop, you can walk around the pond and return to the main entrance this way

Thanks to the Rapid City Rotary for your dedication to a quality park and a wonderful place for families to spend time together!

name: Jake R
text:
Do you have kids? Do they enjoy fun? Do they have emotions?

Yes?

Then your children will absolutely love going to this long-cherished spot in Rapid City. A free play park operated solely on donations, this place was a childhood passtime for me and now it is for my kids alike.

Storybook themed attractions including Disney, Grimm's, and others, your kids are sure to recognize their favorite characters and giggle their shoes off while they push the buttons and turn the knobs on the old train or fire engine.

Fun, free, and your kids will smile. Can it get much better?

Unless you're a troll living under a bridge. Then you may not enjoy this place. No goats to eat. 0/10 if you're a troll.

text: Decent rooms.  Nothing spectacular, but the caulk around the tub was separating and there was mold growing inside the faucet for the tub.  It seemed the hotel had some maintenance issues.

text: Elevator not working, front door broken and had to pry it open, room was filthy, breakfast was unripe apple and granola bar.  I have called twice to speak with management, left my number, but no one has returned my call!  So not acceptable!!

name: Darton Brown
text: Staff is great. Very helpful. Clean room.

name: Lilia Radicheva
text: We stayed for 4 days/3nights. Spacious room with pleasant colors and interior design in white ans teal with a view to some hills covered with snow and pine trees. The front desk were OK, laid back, moderately friendly and organized. Most of them were wearing masks probably because they felt protected being behind the plastic shields/screens. Few guests were wearing masks on the hallways which I found uncomfortable. I liked the interior design and the artistic touch of the antree with the fireplace and the decor. The elevators could be kept cleaner since they get lots of traffic and the area with the buttons had visible fingerprints . The breakfast was consisted of an apple, granola bar and a blueberry muffin handed out in person at the front desk (understandable for Covid-19 precautions). The bedding and the towels were sparkly clean and white and smelled good. The toilet and the bath tub were clean with exception of some public hair left at the spot where the soap stay. The only big cons is the strength of the wireless internet. It was practically useless. Can't log in to an email. Can't order on line. Can't send messages on Viber or sustain FB messenger phone call. Besides that we liked our stay. Our stay was off season, the prices were cheap and there weren't major complaints and we probably be back.

name: Jeffery Scott
text: Really great place actually! Super clean and BRIGHT. 5 star if better options were available for grab and go breakfast, if room service didn't do room checks at 845am and 1045am and if the water pressure was stronger. Would stay here again. Put your do not disturb sign up if you don't want bangs on your door early.

text: Quiet hotel even though it was busy. The shower in our room didnt have much water pressure but was useable. The front desk staff was very friendly. Breakfast was a grab n go bag. Pool was open. text: Very accommodating staff. Pet friendly. Walking area available for dogs to play and go potty. Free WiFi and breakfast as well as a happy hour for adults in the early evening. Rooms were clean; facility is in a clean neighborhood and restaurants are all within driving distance. Price was not that unreasonable either - we took the two king bed studio and that room had two TVs too.

resp.text: Thanks for the review! We will note your comments about the breakfast times.

name: Will Giardino
text: Okay, the rooms at Howard Johnson in Rapid City are pretty good. It's nothing too fancy but also not run down the prices are decent. The service was absolutely perfect. The staff was all friendly and courteous. The location can be a little difficult for Taurus to find as it is set mostly in a residential area behind a high school. but, it is as you would expect any Howard Johnson to be, a very nice place.

resp.text: Thanks for staying with us Will. We appreciate the review!

name: Tim Canaday
text:
Great hotel.  The room was very nice and comfortable.  Bed was fine, I can sleep anywhere though.

Breakfast was your usual fare, waffles, eggs, biscuits and gravy, cereal.  I actually enjoyed the flavored waffles, as most hotels don’t usually have those.

Staff is very friendly and welcoming.

The pool was great for my kids, we swam in it several times while there.  Most of the time the pool was too cold (for me).  The two hot tubs were nice.  It was good to have two.

The location is perfect for getting to all of the tourist locations.

name: Gaye Chercus
text:
I stayed here 2 years ago and it was pretty nice. They were pretty nosy about who was staying with me. They wanted the person's ID when they got their key, not just a nickname/password. Very judgy.  They turned off our keys a half hour before check out so we couldn't get back in our room or in the parking lot door to load up our car. This year of the two hot tubs only one had 1/2 the jets working.

I do want to say the whole place was clean.  The swimming pool was warm enough.  The self serve breakfast was good.

Breakfast was OK, but very carb filled with horrible coffee. The eggs were eighter over salted or just tasted bad. There were no other good sources of protein however.

The room was pretty good, no issues other than old smelling carpet, that you get used to pretty fast. For a place to sleep, it did pretty well in that respect.

text:
Place is normally very busy. This is not a negative, as the staff handle it well. It's just a hopping spot off of I-90 & Deadwood Ave, so between being a hot fueling stop and all of the industrial traffic I would expect crowds.

Place normally has some specials on their clearance table which is nice if you need a snack or happen to need something they're giving away cheap (phone chargers, tie down straps, phone cases or holder, that type of stuff).

name: Chad K
text:
When traveling I really prefer to try locally owned restaurants unique to the area I am visiting. However, we had a steak addict in our traveling party who thinks Texas Roadhouse makes the best steaks ever. So, we ended up here twice on our visit. The first experience was not so great. The second experience was better. Food was as expected. Also, as expected, there's a birthday announcement every 90 seconds as this seems to be the only place people go to on their birthday.

Pro Tip: They won't seat you until your entire party is present, but whether there 3 or 4 diners you'll get the same size table. So, if there's a straggler in your party of 4 just lie and say there's 3 of you. The 3 of you there will get seated at a 4-person table and the late arrival can just join you later.

name: Todd Mitchell
text: We visited the Texas Roadhouse 4-4-21 for a family lunch with family while visiting in Rapid City.  Danielle was our waitress and she did a fantastic job!  The photos are of our sirloin steak w/Sweet potato and pork Chop w/baked potato.  It was a really nice time!

name: Charlotte Leslie
text: Online order included downloading the app. For first time persons wasn't noted you had to. But the hostesses were amazing came in a timely manner. Refreshed our drinks regularly which was nice! Thanks. All in all for was great.

name: Snake Pit Left
text: Victoria was stellar. She was right on with everything. Definitely the highlight of the whole meal! The buns were hot and fresh with the butter and caramel sauce (you have to try it, it's an old Texas Road House Tradition)..The ice cold Margarita was easy on the way down. Gotta add a kicker! The ribs fell off the bone and the toppings on the steak were delicious. Good Baker (loaded of course). The steak was cooked Med well and asked for medium...but here's the kicker...their customer service is top notch. They corrected the issue with no problems and I wasn't feeling bad for saying anything. They were so professional and I appreciated it. I got my delicious steak the way I wanted it and everyone was happy. Quality wait staff/ management...Great pricing for honestly good, quality food. Thank you for a good experience.

resp.text: Snake , thanks for your 4-star review, we’re looking forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Brad T
text: So many restaurants seem to be compromised by lack of staff due to the obvious Covid blah blah circumstances. I was pretty impressed with the way today went. Everything came out good and we had drinks, appetizers & four entrees. Everything was good, including the SERVICE. Keep it up roadhouse.👍

name: Jason Gibbs
text: Amazing experience! We felt right at home and we're treated as family. The food was amazing!! Staff super nice and not afraid to have a conversation. Portions were impressive; my wife and I could not eat it all after having an appetizer before our main dishes, what was left of the dishes filled us up for lunch the next day. We will be back the next time we come to Rapid City!

name: Denise Athans
text: Terrific food. I am so happy that the staff are all wearing masks.

name: Gary Strand
text: Expect a wait if you don't get there when they open. The food and service is great price not bad for a steakhouse. If you good try the appetizers before the meal they are out of this world. The staff is up beat and take really good care of you.

name: Lorri Mertens
text: Excellent service, excellent food.... the warm buns with cinnamon butter hit the spot!!! Pickle chips, salmon, and a loaded baked potato were perfect!!! My daughter enjoyed her steak as well. Blue Moon on tap!!!! YES!!!

name: Bruce Z
text: Good food. I usually get ribs and steak. I always get a baked sweet potato as a side.

name: Sam Taylor
text: Our server was good, the food was good. It just took almost an hour and a half to finish dinner. Our food took way too long to get to us. We seen others seated, ordered, and finish by the time we got out food. Im not talking about a three course meal, I got the classic American burger, wife got house salad and 6oz  and my son got the kids cheeseburger meal. Ill most likely just order to go next time and take it to go.

name: Darren Good
text: Was pretty crowded but, didn't have a extremely long wait for the food.  You have many choices of food. I had barbequed grill chicken.  Most restaurants over cook chicken but the chicken here was cooked perfectly.  Where most chicken is dry and tough this was tender and moist.

name: Jake Killinger
text: Food was good, service was great.  Trying to loose weight so hard to resist those amazing rolls. But I did.

name: Jason McMahon
text: Still my favorite steakhouse. Love the family atmosphere. Great service, great food.

name: Joshua Kosola
text: Amazing! Good food, great service, good atmosphere! They go above and beyond to make to the meal an experience! Thanks

resp.text: Joshua, thank you so much for the 5-star review! It means a lot to us!

name: Brooke Nichols
text: They did a great job being so busy and really tired to make a great time and make sure the food was right. With covid please remember that waiting times have increased and calling ahead is the best way to go. Stay in your car like they ask makes it easier for the staff too

name: Abbigail Gold
text: It took us 2 hours waiting for a table. I called to let them know I was still waiting outside so they don't think I left. I was told 9 mins for a table it became 45 mins. So my table was probably taken away from me. Because I never got a call or text to let me know that my table was ready.

name: Stacy Bruhn
text: It was Awesome!!  Sadie made our Anniversary special!

name: South Dakota Google Review Guy
text: Great food and extremely great service. Crying babies at an all time high tonight but thankfully they left finally. Best steaks in town. Will always return.

name: Duane Dieter
text: Great food. And even better service.

name: Kendra Horn
text: I love this place so much and had our food out so quick to us and the appetizer we were still eating when we got our food...so love them!!!

resp.text:
Kendra,

Thank you so much for taking the time to let us know you
enjoyed your visit with us! We value you and hope to see you soon! :)

name: Willie Chalmers III
text:
If you've been to a Texas Roadhouse before, this is just as good as any other. Otherwise, expect to have a fun time.
If you don't know what to get, I suggest an 8 oz. sirloin. The sirloin was juicy, and the food was warm all around. Our meals were out a little quicker than we expected.
The service was exceptional; our waiter had a conversation with us, and she was very friendly.

name: Keely Evans
text: We stopped in while we were in Rapid City. TRH is one of our fav places to go, this location was probably one of the best we have been to! Our server, (Hunter or something similar) was amazing! He was prompt, kind, polite, and fast! And of course the food was excellent! We highly recommend going here!

resp.text: Keely,  Thank you so much for the 5 star review! It means a lot to us!

name: Barb Pierce
text: Excellent food, though a little cool when we got it.

name: Amber Donze
text: Dinner was good and the service was awesome!!! We go every so often. Have never had a bad experience!

resp.text: Amber, thank you so much for the 5 star review! It means a lot to us!

name: Justin Heubrock
text: Good food and service.  Steak was cooked correctly.  Didn't have to ask for refills.

name: Cj Lambert
text: the staff were friendly as always and the food was also great. drinks were kept full and the food was brought out super quick

name: CJ Engel
text: Went back and had Maddie as our server...she was the best...very efficient and concerned about our service. She was always checking in to make sure if we needed anything.. The food was excellent ..chicken fried steak you can cut with a fork..baked potato just right. .busy place ..plastic between booths, masks were being worn...I felt safe and comfortable...I will be back!!! Thank you!!!

resp.text: CJ, we are sorry you didn't enjoy your visit with us. We'd like the chance to learn more and follow up with you in the next few days. Please connect with us here: https://www.texasroadhouse.com/contact-us/form

name: Hana M
text:
Good quality and quantity !!!
I ordered country dinner-  Beef tips, substitute mashed potatoes to seasoned rice. Definitely recommend you to try it if you like rice 👍

resp.text: Michelle , thank you so much for the 5-star review and kind words ! It means a lot to us!

name: Paula Rouzer
text: My husband & I had good food, his steak was cooked a little more done than he ordered. The tools were hollow at the top, have never seen this at any Texas Roadhouse.. Our friend ordered the cheeseburger, it was really salty or over-seasoned.. she couldn't eat it..  our waitress was great!

resp.text: Paula, we are sorry you didn't enjoy your visit with us. We'd like the chance to learn more and assist you, so feel free to copy and paste your text from your post into this form, and we'll follow up with you in the next few days.: https://www.texasroadhouse.com/contact-us/form

name: Jim Meyer
text: Food, Amazing as always and the waitstaff was impressive considering it was valentines day and dinner rush.

name: Cat Taylor
text: I love the food and this is some of the best service I've ever received. Waitresses are always friendly and helpful. The food is quick and delicious. They've never messed up and order. The only downside is the wait time to get in because they're so busy. But it's worth it.

name: Colorado Beagle
text: Great food and service! Love their birthday celebrations!

name: Jack Mills
text: Services is a little slow but good for 12

name: cherise Marie-Williams
text: Always a pleasant experience here 🤗 we always go for an appetizer and drink lol

resp.text: cherise, thanks so much for the great review! Hope to see you soon!

name: Darren Good
text: Good food,  friendly staff. Clean and safe place to eat.

name: Connie Zeimet
text: Great food and service.  Never disappoints.

name: yemelli oof
text: There food is super good and when its your birthday they have you sit on a sattle (only if you want to😊) and sing you happy birthday, they have their workers dance and have everyone scream Ye ha! I highly recommend going

name: Rocky Knippling
text: Best steaks in town. Great service to top it off!!!

resp.text: Rocky thanks for the 5 stars! We hope to see you again soon!

name: Kevin Martin
text: Amazing service and exceptional food! I love bringing my family here no matter if it’s lunch or dinner!

resp.text: Kevin, thanks so much for the great review! We hope to see you soon!

name: Blob Jelly
text: The food is lovely, right price. Bread is great

resp.text: Bon , thank you for the 5-star Review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Dennis Dalton
text: They were really busy but the service was still good but the prime rib had no flavor very disappointed as it was my first visit

name: Conner Ryan
text: Was good the server was very friendly and checked up on us regularly 10/10

name: John W. Devore Sr.
text: Quick seating, server's were busy and on top of it. Steak was cooked right for a medium. Mushrooms were a bit salty for my liking. Marguerites were perfect.

resp.text:
John ,Thank you for your kind words. We
hope to see you again soon!

name: BlackEarth Java
text: Great service. Really seem to be protecting their employees and guests. Food was great as always from Texas Road House.

name: Jim Hermeling
text: Nice friendly staff, that keep this place clean. Great food, the ribs were excellent as was the sweet potato with fixings. Generous portions.

name: Jimmy Meinen
text: Love the food, have not been impressed with the services as of late.

resp.text: Jimmy ,Thank you for the awesome review. We cannot wait to see you again!

name: Thomas Umgelter
text: It's a Texas Roadhouse, so it's alright. Staff is really nice, our waitress was sweet, so good service and good food. I have no complaints.

resp.text: Thomas, thank you so much for the kind words. Hope to see you soon!

name: Robert Besch
text: Stesk was bad to much grissel

name: Bill Miller
text: A great fun place to dine out

name: Shirley Conroy
text: Loved it great service, frendly

name: Elena MatoTamaHece
text: Savored a to go order of med rare steak, baked tater, yummy dinner rolls &  Caesar salad for two but shared with another. 😁

resp.text: Elena, thank you so much for the 5 star review! It really means a lot to us!

name: Tracy kierzek-Hewitt
text: Delicious food & excellent service! Loved the digital menu!

name: Keith Wilsey
text: Outstanding food, excellent service and properly made cocktails

name: Sean Camille Amann
text: They don't have physical menus anymore you have to do a qr scan on your phone to see the menu. Other than that it's good.

resp.text: Sean, thank you so much for the kind words. Hope to see you soon!

name: Jim Simbeck
text: Great food friendly staff more than enough food and value for the price

resp.text: Jim, awesome to hear! Legendary food and service is our motto! See you soon!

name: Justin McKenzie
text: Great food! Friendly service, our waitress Sarah did a fantastic job! One of my favorite restaurants, and they continue to be consistent across the country!

resp.text: Justin , thanks for the love 😍We really appreciate your review!

name: Jon Morrill
text: We really enjoyed it this week,  not so much last week though. Our hostess Alyssa was amazing this week.  She was kind, funny, entertained us with answers to the crazy questions we threw her way, etc.  Watch the time you go to get better service and food more quickly. I'd recommend this place for a quick gathering with friends as well as a meal with family.

resp.text: Jon Morrill Thank you for your comment. Letting our guests down is never our intention. We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to let us know how we can improve.

name: Justin Hill
text: This place has awesome meats!!!!! Steaks are top of the line and delicious. The staff are so fast they have your drink refiled before you finnish it and they are so friendly. Such a fun place to eat. The kids love making a mess with the peanuts. We stop in for lunch every trip to Rapid City. The prices are so reasonable. You get a better quality meal with great portions for a great price. I have four kids so it is important that we don't go overboard on prices. This place meets and exceeds all expectations. Thank you Texas Roadhouse !!!! Best restaurant in Rapid City

name: Brian David Carrico
text: Best steaks, great atmosphere, friendly people !

name: Darryl Dean
text: Excellent as always. Someone dropped the ball on the cactus blossom, but oh well. Arrived at the restaurant an hour before closing time. Was seated quickly and served that way also. Exceptional service.

name: Mike Stephens
text: Great shopping location. Had everything you need. Located around pretty much anything else you would need also. Right off the highway and easy to get in and out. This is the area to get the most out of a one stop shop

name: Alex Pellegrineschi
text: Very fast service Starbucks. The quality is what you expect. I was pleasantly surprised that the "Doppio" was a real double shot espresso and not a diluted Americano.

name: heather armstrong
text: Only 1 star cause I know the businesses dont have anything to do with the god awful traffic and engineering that went into the design.  I literally could not get out of one of the parking lots because of traffic and lack of lights , signage and street development.  Ridiculous!!!

name: Sean Camille Amann
text: Nice well maintained strip mall with a great variety of stores and restaurants. A bright spot in the blight city that is called Rapid City.

name: Nancy Scheel
text: Good Service but did not have what we needed.

name: Acacia Willey
text: It’s a nice shopping area, but a nightmare when busy. One main road with so many spots where people turn in and out. Trying to leave, turning left can take up to five minutes! Eventually I grow tired of waiting and turn without enough space. Not to where it’s dangerous, but where the oncoming car has to slow down. This area could really benefit with traffic lights.

name: Charlotte Leslie
text: It is totally the new version of the Rushmore Mall except more stores, more parking spaces.

name: John Smith
text: Good chain of stores, definitely something to check out if you feel like shopping and dont want to go to the mall.

name: Andrew Evans
text: The road should be five Lanes too much traffic 35 mph is too fast can never make a left turn it's always crowded and never packed I never enjoy my time down on Rushmore crossing, but that many stores in one place you think this town would have figured out I needed more than three lanes I'm highly disappointed in the structure, parking lot is designed like a maze witch is to confuse the hell out of the average driver, the structure of it sucks so badly more people use the back road then they do the main road which makes getting there and everything just stupid.....

name: Rich Baus
text: It's pretty cool you can get about anything you need!

name: Tanner Sherlock
text: Wish their ammo was a little easier to obtain! But good scheels overall

name: Tena Osborne
text: Nice store. Clean and well stocked. Super customer service.

name: cindy crook
text: Always go here to shop when in rapid.  Alot of different stores to shop.

name: Troy G
text: Scheel's has an expansive selection, based on season.  They have what you need.  Seriously.  THEY HAVE WHAT YOU NEED.  If your hubby is bored while you shop, they have a GREAT coffee shop.  And a mini bowling alley.

name: Cyberhawk419
text: Fun stores especially for snooping around.

name: South Dakota Google Review Guy
text: Huge selection of clothes and sporting goods  but wow do they ask you a million times if you need something. Some people like it but I thought was extreme...I counted one time I was looking at certain items and I was asked 20 times if I needed something. I ended up going to Cabelas...way more peaceful shopping experience.

name: Eric Gor
text: Great food, great service. They follow all the health restrictions for COVID and take good care of their customers. Mostly young people working there so occasionally a food order gets messed up but they are very quick and accommodating to fix it. The smoothies are amazing

name: Sonja Martin
text: Amazing selection of sporting goods, clothing and shoes! They have everything you might want.

text: Outdoor mall in RC. Lots of options to shop. Terrible parking layout though.

text: Went here shopping for shoes, got what I needed and was very fast and friendly...I have no complaints

name: Brian Koehn
text: Really like buying guns from here. Just need more ammunition!

name: Shane Lobstein

name: William Knight
text: Traffic flow is a joke . Very erratic. Needs to be reconfigured for a smoother flow.

name: Vikings fan
text: Visited mens warehouse and was blown away yet again. Bought 2 suits and awaiting tailored to be finished. So happy!

text: Parking lot and street design is very poor, causing extreme traffic congestion at most intersections in and around shopping center.

text:
Another wonderful Darden experience.... Olive garden is part of that corporate restaurant world where every employee is given all the tools needed to provide the best experience for their guests... Today was not their day... First the order, two kids shell pasta w/ Alfredo sauce and meatballs (arrived w/ no meatballs) served with lemonade (kids were not impressed w/ drink) appetizer and margaritas ordered with the lunch soup,salad,bread sticks combo. ALL (except zuppa)arrived not only all at once but still no margaritas... Server was completely overwhelmed and had to be flagged down for EVERYTHING, "um miss ... My kids ordered meatballs, um miss is my soup coming, um miss salt and pepper , um miss.......... I felt I was very patient for the situation, but at the same time when your server apologizes more times than there are seats in the whole restaurant you tend to take it easy on them. I'll be back for sure as this is a first at this location, but for any manager / employee that comes across this....
Some people just aren't cut out for the service industry, if you or someone else can point this out to you please remember it's nothing personal just a nudge saying maybe you should try something else.

Till next time olive garden....... The food was great...... When I eventually received it

text: Had the pick 3 Tour of Italy with the shrimp scampi option. It was the most expensive of the options. When it came to the table it has 3 shrimp on a bed of noodles. We were quite surprised to be paying $16.99 for 3 shrimp, to say the least! When the waiter was asked, he replied that it was, indeed, the correct amount of shrimp. A while later he returned and told us that it was actually supposed to be 6 shrimp and the manager was having more shrimp prepared for the dish. By the time the shrimp finally arrived, we were ready to leave. The fresh shrimp looked like they had just been warmed up and that was all. No seasoning, no presentation, just some shrimp laying in a dish. Very sad. Will definitely not be getting shrimp scampi from Olive Garden again. Was also charged for the "table games" after my son answered 1 trial question on Trivia game! Not sure if we will return at all. Gave 3 stars because although the food was lacking and the place was packed, we didn't have to wait for a table and were served quickly due to the amount of staff on duty.

I havent been able to drink coffee lately (I'm a HUGE coffee drinker) and decided the only coffee I could stomach was Olive Gardens amazing Caramel Hazelnut Macchiato. Something I have taken to ordering every time I go. It was my sole reason for going! Normally I wouldn't complain but something tasted off about this times cup, and I just wasnt all that happy (not bad but not what I wanted) and hate complaining. I decided to say something since it was really the reason I was there. They bent over backwards to make it better and even the manager stopped and asked about my coffee and apologized!!! I really didnt expect so much great service and I've come to realize I can almost always expect great service at Olive Garden! Sometimes things get forgotten but the servers are always quick to get everything and extremely friendly! I think they deserved some kudos for my experience today, so thank you! You don't know how the small things like that can help make someone's day! (Our servers name *according to receipt* is  Aleigha, so Thank You Aleigha! You were great!)

He then proceeded to shadow is while we strolled around.

I have been here several times. Unfortunately it feels like besides the food court and 2-3 stores the mall will probably die if something is not done to revitalize it and attract new stores.

name: Daryl Wagner
text:
First things first, our server Mandi, was delightful. She did a wonderful job... attentive but not overbearing.

During this visit, we used the call ahead seating TR offers. I was told there was a 35 to 45 minute for a table for two. We arrived 33 minutes later and were told it would be ten minutes until our table was available. Ten minutes rolled over to 25 minutes.   No big deal, just be prepared to wait for a table. TR is almost always swamped on weekend evenings.

We were seated in the bar area, which I actually enjoy because it's usually a lot less hectic than things on the main floor. One of my knocks on TR is, and always has been, the noise level. It is tough to carry on a conversation no matter where you're seated... turn down the music. It's a restaurant, not a night club.

My wife and I enjoyed their wonderful rolls, we also ordered the cactus blossom, which tonight was cooked very well. We both had side salad which contained a nice assortment of fresh lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and croutons. My entree was the 16 ounce sirloin with a baked potato. My second knock on TR, and this happens as many times as it doesn't, my steak was cut thinner at one end than the other. That makes it very difficult for anyone cook to prepare a steak as ordered. The thin end of my sirloin tasted good, but was a solid medium well and on the dry side of things. The thicker end of my sirloin was a very nice medium rare, just as I had ordered. The thicker end was definitely more tender and juicier. This was a good meal, not great, but certainly palatable.

text: I am not sure how this restaurant location gets 5 star reviews. We are from Michigan where we loved our Texas Roadhouse location. The first week we arrived in SF we ordered carry-out. They royally messed up our order and they sent us a barcode for a free meal up to 15.99. We tried placing an order over the phone multiple times and were constantly put on hold for egregious amounts of time. Finally today, we decide to call 5 minutes after they opened. The person who took the order didn't even say bye, they just hung the phone up after getting the order. I ordered steak kabobs medium rare, mashed potatoes with sour cream and a house salad. I have never had bad steak kabobs, but these were pretty rough. It was mostly fatty pieces that weren't edible and a lot of charred areas on each piece that made my medium rare steak, incredibly tough. There was no sour cream. The salad was nice. We didn't bother calling them because we can usually never get through anyways and this was our free 'make up' meal for the last bad dinner and offering us another meal, is not even something we want at this point. I eish we would have just got a refund the first time. I don't get it. I don't know how its been this bad twice. We went to our Michigan location once a week if not more and we will never eat here again, not dine in or carry out. I have nothing more to say, medium rare steak should never come out charred.

name: Lisa Huther
text:
My husband usually utilizes the call-ahead seating, which is a nice service. We walked in, received our device, and almost immediately it buzzed to let us know our table was ready.

This isn't just a steakhouse. In the past, I have eaten pork and chicken breast and found both tasty. I stepped out of my comfort zone this time, and, although I have had better chicken-fried chicken other places, theirs was very good. The waitress suggested getting the gravy on the side so the breading would not get soggy halfway through, and I was grateful for the suggestion. The mashed potatoes were good, too, but my broccoli and carrots were barely steamed. The breast had a light breading, which was very nice, and it was a nice size, flattened nicely without being tough. My dinner companions enjoyed their steaks and sides.

The only part of the evening that wasn't enjoyable was the music. At one point, we noticed it had become horribly and uncomfortably loud. We couldn't hear each other talking. My husband asked our waitress could she turn it down. She said, "I'm about to dance. Then we'll turn it back down." She didn't say it with a attitude, truly, but she may as well have. The music stayed up while the dancers were getting together, when it didn't happen quickly enough they turned the music down for a few moments, and then turned it right back up for the dance; after it was over, the music was dropped back to a more pleasant level.

name: Wade Jorgensonyrtu
text:
Great steak.   Attentive friendly service.  What more could you want.

That was my first 5 star review above from 10 months ago.  Went there again last weekend.  Used the call ahead seating.  Called at 6:45pm on a Saturday. Got an estimate of 8pm.  Took our 5 year old to taco bell because he couldn't wait.  He ate in car while we waited in Roadhouse parking lot. We both wanted Prime Rib.  We waited an hour and a half to be seated.  We were told they were out of Prime rib. At 8 o'clock!  On a Saturday!  This is what you do!!!!!  You had one job! OMG. You can roast more prime and hold it in reserve,  I've grown up in the restaurant industry and have cooked in a restaurant myself.  Its inexcusable.   Either that or get a neon sign outside that you can turn on that says WE ARE OUT OF PRIME RIB to save us the disappointment. We ordered Ribeyes instead,  and they were marginal.  Tasted ok, but were overcooked.  We ordered a simple "medium"  and they were pretty much "well-done".  When we placed our order the waitress was like, offended, that I was upset about the being out of prime rib and the fact that our kid wasn't eating.  Remember, he already ate Taco Bell?  So we weren't attended to very well.  No drink refills on our water or iced tea.  It felt like because we weren't drinking alcohol or ordering appetizers that we were treated like an afterthought.  This place is hit and miss.  Its 50/50, you either get an awesome experience,  or you get treated like dogs eating the scraps they are willing to throw you.  I guess you can always load up on bread and peanuts.

resp.text: Wade we are so sorry to hear about your visit with us. Letting our guests down is never our intention. We'd like the chance to learn more and follow up with you in the next few days. Please connect with us here: https://www.texasroadhouse.com/contact-us/form

text: Prices are consistently higher for the same products at all other local stores. The staff are helpful, but the extra cost doesn't go to paying staff spiffs or commission. Would be more inclined to shop at best buy more if that were the case. This would help justify paying more.

He mostly pointed out all the features that were typed up right in front of me to read already. When I asked about the computers ability to last and not bog down after a few months, he said he didn't know how to keep it running efficient, then plugged their geek squad to add to it, this way they could keep it going if something happens. I was speaking more of the hardware keeping up with the times more than software issues. He even tried to use his phone to look up a couple of questions, after waiting for the answer I simply asked google on my phone and got it in seconds what he brought up but couldn't answer in regards to ram upgrades. Delightful people, kind, but not knowledgeable enough sadly.

text: I received a car remote starter kit from Best Buy for Christmas. The cost of the kit was to include installation. When I called after the holidays to have my car remote starter installed, they explained they would have to take my name and a phone number and get back to me. They currently did not have anyone to do the install. I waited for about a month, never received a follow-up call. I then called them back to speak to a manager. He explained they had no one hired to do the install and even after they hire someone it would be at least a few months before he was trained. It is already the first week of February and it is very cold outside! He suggested waiting, going to the next nearest Best Buy which is 400+ miles away, OR I could pay to have someone else do the install and he would reimburse me up to a certain amount. I was not a satisfied customer at this point. I chose to have it installed elsewhere and paid for it out of my own pocket. I then went back to Best buy, which is over 50 miles from my home, and spoke with the manager on duty. He did agree to reimburse me for the entire cost of the install done by another company. At this point .... I am a satisfied customer. It was an unfortunate situation and did cause some inconvenience. But they did make things good, and I left knowing I would be a returning customer.

I never used to enjoy visiting this store, however in the past few months I have come back a few more times and have been impressed with how much better the service and the store in general is. My father and I purchased a complete component home theater system in store as a result of the now super customer service. We both intend to come back soon.

I had to take a star away from my previous review of 4 stars. I was surprised that when I went in to purchase a Sony Alpha Zeiss DSLR lens, not only was I ignored but on my way out the door I was asked if I found everything I came in for. I was empty handed, the employee brushed off my annoyed response of "I will buy it online" without consideration for the loss of a $300 sale. Interesting change in customer service from earlier this year.

We always aim to provide a positive environment in our stores and work hard to ensure our customers feel cared for and listened to. If you have a few minutes, I’d like to gather some more information from you to further understand what happened and better assist. I can be reached via e-mail at ReviewSupport@bestbuy.com. Regards,

Caleb
Best Buy Support

Hanna & Kaleb work in the framing department of Hobby Lobby.
I went there today 2-12-21 Friday
to look at possibly getting something framed as a gift for someone special and new in my life.
I was in kind of a hurry, I wasn't sure what I really wanted. Hanna was pleasantly helpful and showed me matting samples and also frame samples.
Kaleb was merchandising and within ear reach of Hannah and I.
I had agreed to a two weeknwait on a custom frame job, but was still hoping to het it done sooner as Valentine's day is quickly approaching.
I wanted to gift my friend on Valentine's day.
I looked at frames after talking to Hanna. W finding what I was looking for .
With Hanna and Kalebs help, I found a frame and matting that was done in one day.
Thank you so much.
Theses two are a credit to Holly Lobby.
I hope you recognize them for there good work.

text:
Not only do these people have the creative edge they are very warm and friendly too.

We had just opened Graceful Touch massage therapy and needed a sign to help attract attention.

More like we needed resources to get the sign made.

We already had the boards.

Turning here we found helpful friendly guidance that pointed us solidly in the right direction.

When we discovered that we had over purchased for what our needs were they gladly refunded our monies with a smile.

On another occasion I found myself in the picture section of the store and was getting ready to make a relatively pricey purchase.  The clerk saw that it wouldn't be what I would need and recommended another idea I hadn't thought of.

It was a slam dunk hit for me.

Saved me a bundle too I might add.  I gladly return here any time I'm needing help with the creative edge.

name: Alexandra Reynolds
text: Really wanted to like it! Love history and old buildings. I have no problem giving up comforts for historic charm. Unfortunately could not keep hot water in our suite, old brick was half covered up, windowsills needed repair. Though they did have little heaters in the each room of the suite, so the draft did not bother you. Beds weren't the worst- worst amazing either. I'd give it 4 stars if we would of just stayed in the $20 rooms. Location is great and value would be there, but we paid for the largest suite. Furniture in the room was nothing nice or special. The old halls were cool, but slightly concerning as you started looking closer. Love the old building but wish some of the love and grander of the first floor traveled upstairs. If you are going to stay- stay for the cheap rooms, the suite wasn't worth it. Gal and bell hop we had in the evening checking in were great, gal that checked us out in the AM couldn't give two hoots.

name: Gabriel Means
text: The Silverado was lit.  Packed from wall to wall and jackpots going off.  Always a super stellar time at the silverado.

name: Lonnie Cross
text: It was fun watching someone gamble. The buffet was good although the servers weren’t happy.

name: Joseph Greenwald,jr.
text:
Better than I expected. Although I rather gamble.
Thank you

name: Regis Leroy Blodgett
text: An acquired taste. Old hotels have a certain charm

name: Jonathan Nikoleyczik
text: Only went for the Grand Buffet. The food was pretty good, the service was fast, and  the interior was nice and had plenty of seating. I had been to another buffet across town earlier in the week and this one is definitely better. There were lots of options for both hot food and a salad bar. There weren't many options for desert. It loses a star because some of the food had been sitting in the buffet for a while and started to dry out, but this is understandable as it wasn't very crowded on a weekday. I would recommend this if someone is looking for a prime rib buffet in the deadwood area.

name: Dark Matter
text: The ambience of our room was straight from the Victorian era. Our room was amazing, the service was amazing. We went to the emerald room and the server was awesome! She deserves a raise with benefits and whatever else you can offer her. And Ben is the BEST in the kitchen!!! Franklin family, you're awesome and I would love nothing more than to do business with you again!!!!

name: Kevin Shadowfire
text: That crab/prime rib buffet! Without a doubt, one of the best (and only...) Places to locally get all you can eat crab legs during that Friday/Saturday night buffet.

name: brandon kluender
text: fun place good table and slot action

name: Robert S
text: This is an awesome old hotel! Please keep in mind it is over 100 years old. The rooms are small and unique. The breakfast buffet sucks. There was not enough people in the kitchen.
