text: Love love love the Buffett🧚‍♀️ friendly Bar and restaurant staff as well.

name: John Smith
text: Good food, had decent luck gambling, great service!

name: Thomas Walker
text: We love this place. Every thing is always good and the people are very nice.

name: B Tran
text: The food was fantastic and amazing service!

name: T Mel
text: Very good upper end food at reasonable prices. Always enough time to gamble a bit before your table is ready. Lots of fun.

name: Raymond Kent
text: I ate at the buffet. It was smaller than big town casino buffets, but they still managed a nice setting with good food and good selection.

name: Terry Jutila
text: Historic and always elegantly decorated. It's a must stop when you're in Deadwood. Friendly staff and fun slots

name: Levi Olson
text: Lots of machines. Good environment.

name: MOMUNK 2100
text: Went there on a Friday night and ate at the buffet. The crab legs were delicious, only wish I could have eaten more. Probably one of the best buffet prime ribs I've ever had. It's a bit spendy, but I believe you will quite enjoy the food for that price.

name: Nancy Kangas
text: Was a stop on our S Dakota trip. They have a fabulous buffet in their lower level. Prime rib chef sliced ham, lots of side dishes. Delicious Brussels sprouts made like green bean casserole. Only couldn't understand why they start with the meat first and the salad bar 20 feet down the line with the dessert station, which was wonderful. Casino payouts were a little tight. But you only usually go there once on your trip.  Over all was a very nice stop.

name: Christi Folkers
text:
If you're going for gambling and the buffet... Sunday isn't a good day to go it seems. The prime rib was almost like saw dust and they don't serve crab on Sundays so prime rib is just about it. (Besides the very dry piece of fried chicken I tried to eat). Maybe it's because we got there early and ate around 5pm. Idk... but it's Definitely been better!!! Ergo the 3 star rating,  otherwise based only on our Sunday visit it would've been a lower rating.  =(

PS... The whole time we spent gambling Not Once were we offered a drink either come to think of it... c'mon Silverado... we've ALWAYS been your patrons but we could be looking for a new Deadwood hang out soon...

name: Eli Barro
text: Kool spot....Bikini contest was kool

name: Kenny Wyont
text: Just very nice place to be love the atmosphere

name: Terry Zaske
text: The prime rib was dry and over cooked. The crab legs were soft and bland.

name: Chekawa Shabkar
text: Oh boy, dinner could not have been better. The Legend Steak House was truly a dinning experience. Our waiter Bob was the best and I can't say enough about the aged Angus. It was perfect and I want to know how to make the Sweet Potato that came with the meal. It was so good I had to ask for another. I came back the next night for more with my son.

name: Bruce Cerney
text: Everything was spaced out and very clean,  I felt comfortable going in there even though this covid thing is going on.

name: jim runkle
text: Very poor,   cold and old... But did have good service... The hotel is the worst in Deadwood....

name: Steve King
text: Loving gaming here.  Free beer from women in bustiers and stockings.

name: Tennille K
text: First off, I don't like casinos. And I don't gamble. That said, wow, this place brings you back in time! It's beautiful! I would find it more beautiful without all the dinging and flashing lights and machines all over.. makes you wonder what it looked like back in the day! I could spend all day exploring these casinos just to see the woodworking and beauty of the buildings themselves! Amazing

name: Roberta Marske
text: Very Nice Casino. Their Food Is Excellent. I Had Prime Rib. Lovely Salad Bar And Service Was Excellent. Only Cost Me $1.09 Can't Beat That At All. Of Course I Left A Tip. AMEN

name: Teresa Bathke
text: Great Easter lunch..

name: Natt Johnson
text: Fun place to go eat.  Buffet is fantastic with lots of food and great variety for all ages.  I dont gamble but it appears to be a great place to do that.  All kinds of gaming offered.  Drinks can be on the expensive side but plenty to offer.  The place is very clean.  Bathrooms are glamorous and clean.  It is a really nice gambling facility.

name: Brian Hansen
text: We had a great time. Didn't win anything, but that's typical.

name: Colorado Beagle
text: Great food! Legends and the Buffet are awesome!

name: Kimberly DeBusk
text: Fun place. It's a big beautiful historic building. Silverado is across the street. We have stayed here but it was years ago, hopefully they upgraded the rooms a bit. If you do stay here ask for a room at the back. The noise from the street will keep you up. The restaurant in the Franklin is very good.

name: Nick Gale
text: The waitress was fantastic, but the food was not really what I was expecting for the price.

name: Oksana Spencer
text: Nice place to spend time with friends. There is a  restaurant with good food and helpful staff.

name: Gabe Olson
text: The Franklin Historic Hotel did a great job. The Hotel staff was super helpful. The rooms are also very Historic. Room was clean.

name: Susan Wiggins
text: We always stop at the Silverado for all you can eat prime rib and crab legs when in Deadwood. Great food, friendly service and fair price for all you get. Always a good time!

name: ryan kelly
text: Biggest and best steak in Deadwood!!

name: Danette Eggleston
text: Buffet was good. Restaurant staff was friendly. Machines were fun but unfortunately any drink service on the casino floor was non-existent! Good thing the bartender was friendly!

name: Mike Wynia
text: Went for the buffet ...crab legs and prime rib were very expensive and definitely not worth the trip!! Crab legs were small and dry and prime rib was tough !! Waited and hour and a half for a 32.00 plate of yuck ...will not be going back ...server was great though!!

name: Morin Twins
text: Legends restaurant is top notch. They don't take reservations and they fill up quickly.  Get there when they open at 5 to get on the list.   Prime rib $29 for a HUGE serving of meat.  If you go when they aren't busy, you get even more.  I highly recommend sharing it.  NY strip was rather dry and not as tender as I'd expect.  Service was outstanding.  Will definitely be returning.

name: Michelle Mcleod
text: Fun place. Great Buffett

name: Tim Jones
text: Buffett was good. Crab legs were excellent. Prime rib was okay. Desserts were fantastic. Highly recommend the buffet.

name: Chase Newland
text: Great gaming atmosphere and a top notch steakhouse with Legends.

name: fonerules
text: Nice buffet every night with prime rib and Friday and Saturday nights all you can eat Crab legs. Yum. They have chicken and ribs and pizza and ice cream and dessert. Something for everyone even the little ones. Price is high but all you can eat prime rib and crab legs is worth it for sure.

name: Kristy C
text: We ate at the buffet and it was fantastic. They had fresh fruit that was wonderful for the winter season. The food was all fresh and warm. The waitress kept our drinks full and cleared the plates when we were done. We had a food allergy at our table and the kitchen manager was available to talk to. Worth the money!

name: Jordon Jackson
text: Took our brother there for his Birthday. The food was FABULOUS. Waitress was on her game with everything.LOVED IT. WE HAD A GREAT TIME!!

name: Natalie Johnson
text: Food was great.  Buffet ran great.

name: Roma Minder
text: This is a beautiful old building. Each room is unique. We love it here. The housekeeping staff get an a+. It's always very clean and comfortable. They are always very friendly and helpful 😊

name: Samantha Koltz
text: The gambling is always fun! The hostesses and doormen always kind! Had the all you can eat prime rib buffet. The prime rib was outstanding. Other buffet options were very tasty as well. However, 4 of the 7 ppl in our group ended up with upset stomachs a bit later in the day. Not sure what we ate that made us have rumbly tummies... We will go back for gambling. Not sure about the buffet though.

name: Cody
text: The atmosphere is a lot of fun and most of the staff are extremely friendly.  There are a few members of staff that seemed to hate being at work, but they were by far the minority. Also had a chance to enjoy the crab legs and prime rib buffet which was absolutely spectacular.  The prime rib was cooked perfectly and the breaded shrimp was a great addition.  The crab was also exceptionally good.

name: Jeff Ross
text: Had the brunch buffet was mediocre at best

name: Sherri Terrell
text: My first time at the all you can eat crab legs and prune rib!! Excellent!! I loved the crab legs and breaded shrimp!! YUM!!!

name: Taylor Hepp
text: Usually is good but sometimes reminds me of cafeteria food when it should be higher quality. Crab nights are awesome and they do a great job all around. Servers are always nice too!

name: Kelly Crooks
text: My husband and I visited the Silverado Franklin Historic Hotel Gaming, Grand Buffet, and Legends Steakhouse, located in Deadwood, South Dakota on Saturday, August 12, 2018. We had at the All You Can Eat Crab and Prime Rib Buffet. The crab was cold, soft and soggy on our first trip to the buffet, which was disappointing. Our next two plates of crab were fresh, hot and easy to crack. Besides crab, the only other food we ate was dessert. I had sugar free pie and my husband had German Chocolate Cake. My pie was very good but my husband said his cake was dry and tasted odd. The service was excellent! The lady who was taking names for seating sent is downstairs for a table immediately. The person who took our beverage order returned with our drinks promptly. Our waitress was friendly and provided superior service. The buffet was priced too high for what was offered. Beverages, including sodas, were extra but I believe they should've been included in the already outrageous price. Overall, our visit to this establishment was slightly above average.

name: Matt Bitz
text: Five dollars to park in a parking lot that isn't even there's. For that 5 bucks we were told we could exchange a coupon for player credit. No biggie. After we find out there's a 2 hour wait, we go see if we can at least play some slots and use the coupon. Nope. To use the coupon you've got to sign up for their players club and jump through even more hoops. So we left after 5 minutes, asked the gentleman in the parking lot if we could give him his coupon back and get our money since we were literally in and out. Nope. Such a scam. It's not even the 5 bucks I'm mad about. It's the fact that you know this place is making money hand over fist and they nickel and dime people because they can.

name: Sherry McCloskey
text:
Had a very fun time here although the 1cent machines are confusing as they now have a 50c minimum. A lot has changed but it was still fun for us.
Spent our $20 minimum and left with $45 yay!
Most importantly have fun with our visiting family from Chicago 💞

name: ryan borgheiinck
text: Love the casino but the buffet sucks. $30+ and not many choices.  The staff is friendly and helpful.

name: John Roman
text: We whent to legends Steak House.  One of the better meals we had in town.  Try and get the prime rib.  Sat in the bar and service was excellent.  Drinks where good as well.  Side dishes need a lot of work.

name: Chrissie Francoli
text:
Food was good but there was a very long wait. We called ahead for reservations and they said they dont do reservations. They mentioned at that time it was a slow night and they weren't busy. When were got there 10 minutes later, we were informed that the wait was 1 hour and 40 minutes.
The hostess downstairs was very nice and seated us immediately. She also made sure the tables were clean. The lines for the buffet were extremely long and unorganized.

name: Michael Hawken
text: Nice place to stop by n gamble.  BETTER YET THEY HAVE  FULL BUFFET  DOWN STAIRS EVERY DAY,  THEY DO HAVE A ELEVATOR  ALSO TO USE FOR ANY ONE OR WHEEL CHAIR CUSTOMERS TO USE

name: Susan Carter
text: Went there for a bite to eat after work. I forgot it was Valentine's Day. The wait for a table was about an hour, but they had one seat at the bar. The environment was lively - a lot of drunk couples. They were pretty funny. I had the dry aged bison ribeye and it was delicious. The bartender recommended the truffle mac and cheese.  Overall it was a very nice experience. Next time I'll try the lamb.

name: Wendy lee Truxton
text:
Buffet opens at 4:30. Line started at 4:00. Best to be at the front of the line, to get seated at a table closest to the buffet, so the crab legs and prime rib are hot when you sit down to eat.
Slightly over priced, ($27.99 ea.) but it's not every day that a person eats there. More for a date night or just because.
The crab legs were delicious and the prime rib was a little fatty, but overall a good meal.

name: ralph hartsoe
text: Beautiful casino.. short visit in here on a motorcycle ride through the town. Loved this place.

name: Shelly
text: Awesome steak dinner prepared perfectly...best meal ever!!

name: Jm W
text: Way over priced for the quality of food, selection of food, and cost. The staff was excellent. Drinks filled on the reg, napkins in a flash and friendly smiles everywhere. The wait was unrealistically long. Almost 2 hours. When were finally seated we walked by plenty of empty tables on the way to ours. Most of these tables stayed empty the entire time we were there. While people were still waiting upstairs. The crab was cold and over cooked. Only one chicken option and it was cold. Good luck eating vegatarian, the guy making pizzas had no clue if they had meat on them or not. A lot of the dishes were still dirty in the clean stacks as well. This was my 1st time ever in Deadwood... Total drag for the outrageous cost

name: Red Faux
text: The Restaurant was good. I had the Duck "Wings" (actually legs but....) with an orange glaze that was tremendous. The steak was pretty good, cut was great but not seasoned at all and a little bland. I would give it 2 stars if I was including the attitude from our server, Courtney, who acted like we were totally disturbing her. Very dull, disinterested in us and kept rolling her eyes as she was walking away. It was our first time, never ate there before but we ordered the app right away. We needed a little time to order our entree but did so before the app came out and were gone half an hour before they closed so I'm not sure what her problem was. Her loss, in tip. We normally tip WAY better than that. But decent place to eat, prices just a little high for that kind of food. Previously had just cheesecake at the bar (they were slamming busy) with peach rum glaze that was incredible. We weren't adding that to her tab this night tho.

name: Sue Nelson
text: Fun town, great hotel and restaurant!

name: Mickey Strand
text: We came to eat at Ledgends stake house.  It is so good we came back twice in one visit.  Staff is friendly and knowledgeable on food and the restaurant.  We will be back soon.

name: Jeremy Stubbs
text: All you can eat Buffett was legit And a pretty awesome casino to boot

name: Eddie Hebron
text: Very Historic!

name: Jessica Mckee
text: Love this place. Such a great get away in the historic Franklin and the food at Silverado is so so so so good. Everyone we have ever encountered there has been nothing but wonderful.

name: Kim Goldsberry
text: Excellent food . .  .social distancing on slots

name: Roxann Janz
text: I love the all you can eat crab buffet. There's plenty of other things to eat too and all very tasty.

name: ssynee
text: we went to the crab buffet, it was good. but it was too busy due to the rally, so table was  cleaned so slow

name: Melissa Durbin
text: Great place to play and relax.

name: Ghuu Gyfty
text: Great Breakfast good people.

name: Branden Miller
text: History is it's best feature. In dire need of updated amenities.

name: Eric Gor
text: The buffet is the best/only in town but definitely NOWHERE near a Vegas style like they claim. First of all, the hours are pretty bad. Secondly, it's TINY. You'd be better off at a Golden Coral. But at least the price is reasonable. It's only $13.95, which is about what you pay for a sandwich at any other restaurant in town. So if I'm eating in Deadwood, and I'm within their short operating hours, then this is where I eat

name: Alex Conklin
text: All you can eat Prime Rib and Crab Legs on Friday and Saturday....not too shabby!

name: Connie Knodel
text: They could have had better games to gamble with and I had a gin and tonic to drink and I couldn't drink it because the gin was so much that I left it on a game Los  Vegas Casinos make better drinks than this

name: Dani Ellerton
text: My family and I came to the Silverado for their crab leg and prime rib buffet. The crab legs were over cooked, but large and plentiful. I wish the prime rib was a little more rare, but it was still quite good. Any of the other dishes were only just ok, but we really only cared about the prime rib and crab legs. That alone made it a 4 star experience.

name: Kent Craig
text: Great buffet @ Silverado.  Did not try steaks @ Franklin.  Both filled with Victorian stylings.  Facilities are smoke free but smoking is allowed just outside of doors.... had to walk through smoky area to get into & out of buildings.  Recommend walking down hill and riding trolley back up, but not a difficult climb unless you're not used to the elevation.  Visited in October, area was busy, some shops closed for season or closed early.  Was windy but sun was warm.

name: Paul Schell
text: Great place. Great history. Supposedly haunted. Didnt see any ghosts while we were there. No hot tub. Parking is small.

name: Prescott Witte
text: My wife and I had the 10oz sirloin, and I honestly don't think I will ever have a steak that compares to this in my lifetime. Talk about melt in your mouth! And the sides, my God! The garden salad, the chili soup, the bread, the green beans and rice - absolutely amazing! And our server, Jason, was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We will be back very soon!

name: Amy Moen
text:
I continue to feel 50/50 about this establishment, depending on the subject. Their weekend buffet is always a popular draw, serving up "all you can eat" crab legs and prime rib. In my past experience, the average wait time to be seated in the restaurant for the buffet is about one hour. Unless you're absolutely starving, the wait time passes fairly quickly while you wander around the casino,  play a few machines, or just kick back and watch all the other people. The buffet is like any other one you've ever been to, a hit and miss on either crab or prime rib. At $30 for each adult buffet, it shouldn't still be an issue after all these years. Wait an hour to be seated,  and then another 15 minutes to get a hunk of meat. Really??? Kinda sad, yet I keep going back every 6 months or so, hoping that maybe this time everything will work out like it should.
I have spent the night in the historic Franklin hotel at least one dozen times, but decided I've spent the last one there just this last January 18th. The rooms are "okay", but they're not equipped with coffeemaker, fridge, microwave. Just a tv and bed, therefore, very overpriced. The staff couldn't have been any grouchier or unmotivated. No smile, no welcome greeting, or eye contact at all from the gal at front desk while we were checking in. I'm done staying with them. Legends restaurant is the bomb, though. No complaints where this is concerned. Delicious food, great service every time.

name: Cynthia Niswonger
text: Service was attentive.  Food was well prepared.  My husband and I ordered steaks they were cook perfectly and tasted great.  The restaurant is upstairs from the casino  The kids got a kick out of watching people play blackjack below while waiting for our food.

name: Marin Malo
text: Silverado hosts the best restaurant in town, Legends, now that Kevin Costner closed down Jake's atop the Midnight Star Casino. It's Casual Fine Dining: good food, cheap to draw in casino players. The staff at Legends is a lot more efficient than the casino staff and generally more professional It can take hours to get a soda from the upstairs bar. I love the doormen!

name: Derek Sohlberg
text: There is parking right across the street which is nice. There are electronic games and physical games. The food there was good and reasonable in price. We waited 2 hours to be seated but it was a Saturday night which is the prime rib and crab legs buffet so the wait was expected.

name: Pete Ducheneaux
text: Good game selection adequate space. Buffet is well worth the trip.

name: Conrad Law
text: Fantastic historical Hotel.  The place is worth the trip without even going in to the gambling, the food, and the great service.  Don't miss it.

name: Darlene Poppe
text: We were celebrating a birthday.  Requested a table for 9 at the buffet.  They said it wasn't possible.  We would have to sit at 2 tables.  Not acceptable!  So we left.  Steak house across the street had no problem accommodating us.

name: Carmen Schwartzkopf
text: Love this place to get away plus some of the rooms are haunted

name: Mike Yocum
text: Food, service  and price is something you will like about about  this place.

name: Gregg Hook
text: Always enjoy the Franklin. The detail that the hotel has gone to, to keep with its historical roots is great. A lot has changed in the last 15 years, but at the core it is still historically beautiful while being modern at the same time. Always our first and favorite stop

name: Tracy Meier
text: I am in the drawing to win the Harley! And I'm on my honeymoon! Does it get any better!

name: Jona Creswell Gray
text: It's a good place to gamble and a good atmosphere just all-around good people.

name: Brandon Bennett
text: Complex is well kept. The casino is well lit and has a variety of games. The buffet is without equal. The casino is clean and staff is well dressed.

name: Alecia H
text: The Legends steakhouse is by far my absolute favourite place to eat in the entire state. Their service is always on point and I have ordered from every corner of that menu and am yet to be disappointed. Love it!

name: Zach Klug
text: Amazing breakfast at legends steakhouse. Can not wait to go back and try something different off the menu.

name: Derek Livermont
text: Great game selection. The cocktail service can leave a little to be desired depending on the night but overall, one of the best casinos downtown. Legends steak House is also one of the top places to eat

name: Jesse Morrison
text: Not a lot of winning here, I even heard some of the locals saying that winning is few and far between...

name: Jane Gorecki
text: Not much playback and not as many machines as Laughlin's, but they do have all the newest ones

name: Mike Johnson
text: Slot machines are way to tight! Not really sure what more to say. It is a very clean casino but your diffently paying for it

name: Christine Nelson
text: Great food...great service !

name: Justin Engbarth
text: Buffet has a nice selection, prime rib was 8 out of 10

name: Robert Mentecki
text: Ok food with ok prices and great service

name: Michael Arieta
text: Buffet was great. Thier new years eve celibration was really fun.

name: Steve Watkins
text: Must have had a fish special on the buffet last night.  The whole place smelled terrible. I like the place in general.

name: Steve
text: The food was excellent. Memorial Day lunch was not crowded but variety was lacking. It was a slow Monday.

name: Chelsea T Jahn
text:
I was a consistent regular this hotel. I have spent a lot of money on rooms. Well, when I walked in last week to check in, there was a worker at the desk named Michelle. I am not sure if it's because I am a young blonde girl with crazy tattoos and lime green and pink hair, or if it's because I'm not a machine/blackjack player who they profit greatly off. Or possibly if she simply had a bad day, which we all do.
But right when I walked up to the desk with my friend (who I specifically took there because he had never seen the place and i talked abkhf jf), Michelle quickly asked my name. I told her and she said my 2-night reservation was canceled. I took out my Chromebook and shared my itinerary from price line, stating my reservation was all paid and secured. Michelle literally yelled, "well I don't know! Call them and ask!" I maintained my calm (i do not do well with a raised voice towards me from most) and told her that was very inappropriate and unneeded to yell at me when I simply asked a question. She said, "well You're asking me stuff that isn't my problem!"
I believe that her job to complete my reservation is her problem, I could be wrong though. I told her that even if it isn't her problem, she just talked to me very rudely and it was unnecessary. I told her it was terrible customer service, especially at a nice casino and hotel. She gave me a hostile look and called the manager to the front. The manager came and recognize me right away from my previous stay. I handed him my 100 dollar deposit and he quickly told her how 2 check me in. She acted all surprised. He walked away and she handed me my keys to the room. I had specifically asked for a nonsmoking Rome. I had even gotten an email from the hotel prior stating that my accommodation with non-smoking benefits will be fulfilled I then went upstairs and open my room door. There was nose non-smoking sign outside of it. It wreaked like cigarettes. It was clearly a smoking room. I went back downstairs and asked her to please give me a non-smoking room as I had been promised for my two night stay. She said without looking at her computer sorry I'm all out of those. I again showed her my itinerary and the promise that this would be fulfilled during my stay. Her manager walked up again and asked what was going on. I quickly told him that she says there are no non-smoking rooms available. He looked at the computer and showed her that they're obviously were. She then handed me a new set of keys and acted suddenly very friendly. Maybe she felt bad or was scared she would get caught. I was upset over a situation and told the manager at the front desk about it the next day. They did not offer any accommodations or vouchers let alone a free night. As a touring poker player I know for a fact that this hotel does not depend on the hotels rooms 4 income. As I don't play machines or blackjack I do not believe she cared whether I stayed or not. The main reason I loved this was because of the nostalgic it brought back for me love the Beautiful Victorian home I grew up in. I will never go back there more than likely. Had they accommodated me in some way or shown that they or taking her rudeness towards me, a loyal guest, as an intolerable interaction, I probably would have been back again. The last time I will ever be there. Maybe the gamblers get treated better parentheses but I do not recommend this place 4 just staying for leisure. I hope Michelle was having simply a bad day or gets a job she is happy with. They definitely should have given my friend another night at least. For he had $940 in his pocket to gamble but refused to do that auto place who tolerated someone treating me in such a way. I hope nobody else who goes here has this experience.

name: fonerules
text:
Go carts are fun. They have one that will excite everyone. Slow go carts for younger kids and double carts so even the little ones can ride and smile all the way around the track. The fast carts will go 40 MPH. With a tight winding track it is a challenge for even the most dedicated racers. The laps time are recorded for the fast carts so you don't have to pass someone to beat them. All the carts are remotely controlled to keep the racing safe and fun. The track attendant can cut power to one or all the carts. That way the trouble makers won't ruin the fun for everyone.
There's arcade games and batting cages for a variety of fun for everyone.

text:
Booked birthday party for my 8 year-old son. Very disappointed. You get nothing special for booking a party. The boys had to wait for any activities, often there was no "attendant" to be found. Then I was told I needed to get our cake & balloons out of there 1/2 hour before the end of the time I had booked the "party" for because someone else was coming. So that further limited what the boys had time to do.
When I paid before leaving (not cheap!) I noted how much our group had to wait. I was told i was lucky, as it was the slowest Saturday they have had on a long time. Usually waits are much longer!
The only reason I didn't give a one-star review is that, when they did get to do laser tag or bumper cars, the boys had a lot of fun.
If you want a birthday party here, book a weeknight! Saturdays are a disaster.

resp.text: Samuel, thanks for taking the time to leave us a review.  We think the facility is great for a wide variety of events and agree there are some great small venues in town hosting some pretty awesome shows.  Rapid City and the surrounding Hills offer up so many great things for everyone and we are glad to be apart of it.  The prices in the facility are not set by the City but rather by us here at the Civic Center.  We do realize some items are definitely higher that what you'd find at a local restaurant, however there are many factors at play.  We regularly to cost comparisons with other facilities like ours and find that our pricing is still substantially less than what you might find there.

text: The place seems horribly run during events. High fees and some of the worst concession stands Ive ever seen. There are so many times I've just decided not to bother waiting in line to give them $7 for $0.50 because of it

resp.text:
Bhighi -  We're sorry to hear that you have had a terrible time here.  We understand that coming to events can be expensive.  We continually to price comparisons with other venues in the area (Casper, Lincoln, Sioux Falls, Bismark etc) and in most cases our concessions are priced similarly if not less than these other venues for similar events (concert vs concert, sporting event vs sporting event, etc.).
Staffing can be an issue from time to time.  As we are sure you've noticed we use a lot of volunteer groups in the venue.  A large number of them do work our concession stands with one or two Civic Center employees helping them out.  This is a great way for groups to raise funds, and one way we are proud to help give back to the region.  However, it does mean that they might not always be as quick as someone who was employed for every event.  This program is something we evaluate annually, so if there was enough feedback to warrant change we would.
Thanks for taking the time to give us your thoughts.  We appreciate them.

name: Chelle Ray
text: The food was good. Not very good customer service. Was not crowded and our drinks were not refilled even once.

name: Fern Patterson
text: Great food at a great price. Servers are fabulous.

name: JoyScott Engle
text: Food was good, Staff was nice but we asked for drinks a bloody mary and Pot o Gold Colada and they really really skimped on the alcohol kinda sad that an establishment cant be honest to give their customers good value.  Definitely disappointed.

name: Denise Fletchall
text: Food was AMAZING!!! Getting our food was slow. 31 min wait from order to getting it. NO SOCIAL DISTANCING unless you ask for it!! They tried to group everyone together in the far back corner. We ask to be seated out from other ppl. The waitress rolled her eyes at us. But she did comply.

name: Jessica Zimmer
text: My sons steak was taken immediately away and I forgot to take photographs. Hugely disappointed in the burgers being not what we ordered and brought out with very few cold fries. My husband and his nephews burgers were cold and overcooked to tough.  Steak was not as ordered it came over seasoned and extremely well done. My son ordered Rare. My chicken and shrimp were so overspiced and overcooked no one at the table wanted leftovers. The chef had flipped the burnt side down. No onions were ordered with a ONION allergy clearly stated multiple times. All plates included onions. I love applebees in Burlington, WA. Here? I wont be returning. The manager redelivered food multiple times and by the 3rd time being delivered what we didnt order we paid our tab , tipped the waitress for refilling our drinks x2 and left.

name: Rebecca Lyon
text: Very slow service (2hrs) not very friendly. But even worse was the food is absolutely horrible (she admitted nothing was fresh). We all 3 got boxes for full plates and ran to the bathroom. Burnt, watery, discussing food and she still charged us full price. We should have taken the hint when one person got a stomach ache after her strawberry lemonade! It only got worse from there. Pretty sure we're never coming back again. 🤮

name: Mary Duncan
text: Our dinner was perfect and exactly as described by our waiter Brian whom by the way was the BOMB!!  Great personality and on the ball.

name: Roderick D. Schad
text: Used to love this place, but it seems their menu items are going down hill. But, their tap beer is good.

name: Jenna Callaway
text: Great place for a date or with family.

name: Michael Stevens
text: 50 min to get food. Complained a little, waitress wouldn't bring the ticket or check on us. Foos was good, service not so much.

name: Weston Moe
text: Always good service. Always good food.  Great atmosphere and love the music they play now.

name: Sean Crooks
text: Thought we'd give it a try after seeing commercials for a new menu. They have the same menu, sadly. They forgot the chicken on my gf's pasta and chicken entrée and offered to take $1 off. They were out of one side I ordered and weren't going to mention it until I asked about it. They substituted it with another side after I asked. Sorry Applebee's, we won't be giving you another try.

name: Brad Littleton
text: Good food. Good service.

name: Vanessa Walker
text: Smh very disappointed. The food was greasy. I got the wrong soda. The club lacked the lettuce it had in the photo. Waitress kept forgetting stuff. 😒

name: Debbie Zwingelberg
text: I didn't think it was very good at that particular one.

name: Emma Bartels
text: Totally like this restaurant. Super respectful employees at both places spearfish and rapid city. Always nice and clean. Great food

name: ts420
text: Everything is pretty much perfect here. Only thing is when you order a steak and you want it medium rare you should order it medium then it comes out the way it needs to be. Drink prices are the right price also. 🍻

name: Wayne Anderson
text: Good place to eat the menu is better and the food tastes better.

name: Cynthia Lewis
text: Enjoyed the combo plate, good conversation, great service!

name: Amanda Greenwald
text: Absolutely the best service. We were there for lunch and it was served in a timely manner. My 4 year old son was given some apple sauce to hold him over until his food arrived. Compliments to the server and the cook 😁

name: Cruisin Susan
text: Did 2 for $22 with son for lunch...fiesta lime chicken

name: Cindy Bland
text: I have never eaten at this location. We didn't even get there until about 1030. I didn't know they closed at 11 until 1130 when we finally noticed that we were the only two people left in the restaurant. The staff were so friendly and acted like they were perfectly content waiting until we were finished. We will definitely be eating there again

name: Gregg Wooten
text: Great job. Amber at the bar was excellent. Courteous, friendly and got me taken care of asap. Missed one thing on a to go order but fixed it immediately and with an apology for the simple oversight. I'll keep coming back. Thank you guys.

name: Brandon Kugler
text: Good food

name: Callie Ackerman-Jasper
text: Generally good service. Fast lunch so you can easily come here during your lunch hour.

name: Elizabeth Tokarczyk
text: It took quite a while to get seated.It also took some time to get some of our drinks and I found a hair in my blended beverage from the bar. They forgot to bring a bread stick with one of our meals and then eventually corrected their mistake. Overall it wasnt the greatest dining experience..

name: Donald Whiteman
text: Great services woman are superb

name: WoIvezpack
text: This is some fabulous food. The main course was great and the desert was exquisite. I recommend the blue ribbon brownie. It was amazing.

name: A.C.A.B
text: Great food. Our waitress was awesome!

name: Lorna Ader

text:
Simply among the Best 1/8th mile Dragstrips in Division 5.
They hold all the NHRA Divisional Bracket races as well as the specialty races ( King of the Track, National Dragster Challenge race, etc.) They have Friday Night Street races, special Corvette, Camaro, Mustang races, and best of all they race at night as well, a very welcome twist to run in the cool of the evening. They also hold the Sturgis Bike Rally Drags too during bike week and even hold top fuel drag bike races.
A full service Old time Drag Strip....you can "run whatcha Brung" and Bracket Race or attend one or all of the Special Race Weekends....what ever you prefer, Sturgis Dragway is there to provide a nice Drag Racing experience for all.

name: R R
text:
Wife and I got the 2 for $25 meal. It's 1 appetizer, 2 main courses, 4 sides, and a desert to share.
(Bear in mind no listed extras gave us an upcharge)
For the app we got the Texas fries. They came with melted shredded cheese on top which completely hardened by the time I got it home (to be expected, fries and melted shredded cheese don't travel) but I got it with extra bacon, extra green onion and extra jalapeno. We smothered it in their ancho-chile ranch which was freaking amazing.

My wife and I share all the food we order so  we decided on the crispy honey chipotle chicken crispers and their original ribs. The crispers were just how I remembers. tender meat and perfect breading. My wife wasn't a fan of the aroma of the sauce but I thoroughly enjoyed it. Tastes AMAZING dipped in their ancho-chile ranch.

The half rack of ribs was larger than expected and the meat fell off the bone. I think next time I will try the honey chipotle or house bbq ribs. they tasted great.

For our sides we got corn on the cob, coleslaw, mexican rice, and mashed potatoes. The coleslaw was good, just regular old slaw. The Mexican rice was good, just regular mexican rice. The corn on the cob I thought would be half an ear of corn but it was a full corn cob. It was a little soft but probably because it stayed in the tinfoil too long. the standout was the mashed potatoes. extra bacon and extra green onions on them with cheese. delicious with the ribs.

Finally the cheesecake. It was only one piece but it was a large piece. They could have sliced it in half and served it as two slices and I wouldn't complain. I thought the texture was soft for my liking but it WAS in a bag with ALL hot foods.

I gave that meal 5/5 and my wife and I have enough left overs for 2 more meals for each of us. For only 25 bucks and 20 minutes wait it's an absolute steal.

name: Abby Stevens LaCroix
text: I stayed here for my wedding night. That night was alright. The room was so beautiful! It was the jacuzzi loft suite. Definitely a splurge in the $$$ department. We expected the very best. The first night after our wonderful wedding, I cut my foot on some glass, likely from a wine glass that wasn’t completely picked up from the guests before us. No big deal right? Yeah it wasn’t that big of a deal. Glass is hard to see sometimes. I opened the fridge the next night and there was a half eaten sandwich from Arby’s. Ok gross, like isn’t that something that is supposed to be checked?? That same night we were sitting in the jacuzzi, enjoying ourselves, watching a little tv and we hear a loud knock on the door. When do you ever hear a knock at night at a hotel?? My husband leaves the jacuzzi to see what’s going on and then he sees the water everywhere on the floor. No the jacuzzi did not overflow. Somehow it leaked everywhere, pipes burst or something. It took maintenance about two hours to leave. We sat on the top of the loft suite, where the bed is, distraught. This sucked for what we were going to be paying. The next morning my husband went down to talk to the people at the check in desk. We wanted them to do something to make it better. $100 back, an extra night to make up for the bad one even if it was a different suite, anything, just something! Nope, nothing. Damon, my husband, explained that I had also cut my foot on some glass. They didn’t care. As he was walking away he even heard the ladies saying that he and I staged getting the glass in my foot or made it up. What bs! We payed about $800, more than our months rent for just two nights. Does this experience sound like it’s worth it? Do you want to risk getting some glass in your foot or maybe having your room flooded? Pick a different hotel for your trip to good ole Rapid City!!! :)

name: Lisa Huther
text:
This Arby's is in a truck stop. There was a line, and we hoped it moved quickly.

The young lady working the counter was cheerful, she took my order correctly, and after the crowd cleared, she went out to wipe tables. The cooks and preparers were moving quickly, and the crowd was taken care of in a timely manner.

We only had one small hiccup; my shake was prepared first and was sitting where a customer came to dispute a item on her ticket. When my order was handed to me, I asked if I could have another shake prepared since the woman had been so close to it. At any other time, I might not have said anything, but we are in the age of COVID-19. While the person seemed to think my request was silly, she didn't say it verbally, and made me another shake.

The quality of the food was "meh," but this isn't the fault of the workers. The french fries weren't the same quality as in the past; there were a few tiny curled fries, and the rest were broken pieces. The packet of Arby sauce wasn't good. The hot ham and Swiss I used to "love" was so salty, I couldn't finish it, and the jamocha shakes I used to order all the time, the last two times (here and in Grand Forks, ND) just haven't had a good identifiable jamocha flavor.

text: Great place to stay in Rapid City has a big water park right next door to it and Perkins Restaurant right at the other end

name: Darci Salmen
text: Excellent breakfast, nice room. Helpful staff.

name: Stephanie Gibson
text: The rooms seem to be really nice and clean and the Staff has been great. It's a great location with watiki right inside.

name: Jerry Hiebert
text: Staff was very helpful and friendly.   Good breakfast Very nice and clean rooms attached water park was fun.

name: Darold Wieczorek
text:
Pic up and drop off guest from airport staff are great and help full

Thanks

Liv Well,

Assistant General Manager
Fairfield Inn & Suites-Rapid City

name: Sriram S Raghavan
text: The rooms are decent. Hate that they don't give a closet in room and the room isn't big enough. They do serve good breakfast in the morning

name: Vicki Weingart
text: Nice rooms at an incredible price. Breakfast included. Attached to water park

name: David Lampa
text: Nice uplifting hotel, great service, great prices

name: Pamala McNeff
text: The hotel staff was very nice and accommodating for myself and my client. They went out of their way to serve our needs.

name: Melissa Prostrollo
text: I had to call Eastgate Towing last week about a car that was towed to their facility. The woman I spoke with was kind and knowledgeable, giving us all the information we needed about next steps and was considerate of our time - helping us not to have to make multiple trips out there, when we could consolidate into one, if we did things in the right order. I appreciated her smart advice and helpfulness.

name: johnny theophilus
text: even at 4am, the tow was a breeze like they were cuttin butter.

name: MAtt Vanwagner
text: Excellent service won't go through anyone else to tow my vehicle

name: Chelsea Karlson
text: False advertising it says 24hrs that your open but yet you cant answer my question

name: James
text: If I could give them zero stars that would be correct. Bridget, that seems to run the show over there is one of the worst human beings I've ever encountered in business. I don't know how they make it but it certainly isn't on goodwill or trying to help people out of a bad situation. I just still cannot believe how poorly we were treated down there, what they demanded and how we even got out of there with our skin. Absolute worst towing company in Sioux Falls. With the most terrible human beings I've ever dealt with.

name: Chad Hennings
text: All about the money not a bit concerned about the customer. Wouldn't recommend them to anyone that might need a little understanding and respect. Was told the owners were very kind and helpful but wasn't even allowed to speak to them upon request! My daughter was denied her car seats and property unless she paid almost 2000$ for a vehicle she was unaware was even in their possession. They can keep it and the stuff inside for that kind of greed. Not everyone in Sioux falls has class or is considerate of a person's circumstances!

name: Lori Gerlach
text: Amazing company!! They were prompt, friendly and extremely customer service orientated. Treated me with kindness and went out of their way to help ensure I was taken care of.  I had my car towed to a repair shop and the next day they called the repair shop to ensure the receipt was in my car and to save it for me. Very impressive, honest, trustworthy company. I am recommending them to everyone.

resp.text: Hi Lori! Thank you for your great review, and we are pleased to hear you had a great experience with Eastgate Towing & Storage Inc!

name: John Smith
text: Great people to work with.

name: Joe Miller
text: Use them all the time, highly recommend.

name: Laura Herbst
text: They were exactly the type of people I wanted to work with when my tire blew out at 6:30AM on the way to work. The person on the phone answered all my questions and quickly took my information. The serviceman who changed my tire got there in a reasonable time, had a great attitude, and took care of everything quickly. They made it a painless and calm affair which helps when you're panicking about work.

name: Missy Powell
text: The staff - especially Keith - was very helpful when I needed a tow in a pinch. I highly recommend Eastgate Towing.

name: Michelleé Lynn
text: They were very helpful!

name: D N
text:
Been dealing with them for years on and off. Use to work nextdoor as well. Anyways whenever I've needed a tow I call Eastgate Towing.

I called them last week for a neighbor due to language barrier who lost a wheel down the street from there and they were there within a couple minutes and promptly towed it over to his house. The neighbor was very happy as well.

After the neighbors Insurance company looked at his car yesterday his insurance company asked me to have it towed to the body shop and when asked who I thought I would call and I said Eastgate Towing and the Progressive senior adjuster locally said they use them all the time so just have them haul it and they'd tie up the loose ends.

I will continue using and recommending them. You treat them with respect you get respect in return which is pretty much the same anywhere you go in life these days. Never had a negative experience as others have complained about and I don't see how others could unless they were being rude.

name: Mike Sorensen
text: These guys get it done, even on Sunday

name: Keith Smith
text: Very professional company.  Driver was courteous and professional.   Reasonable time frame.

name: Lissa Hendricks
text: Everyone was friendly, but i was extremely put off by the cigarette smoke the was so thick that I ended up with a headache. My clothes and hair stunk from cigarettes and I was not in the office very long. There were even children present in the smoke filled office. Even our vehicle smelled like cigarettes. Again the employees were friendly, it is just the extreme amount of cigarette smoke that I object to.

name: TR Risk
text: Not sure what the person who answers the phones problem is, but she is insanely rude. Permanently lost my business.

name: Sid Rollings
text: Terrible expensive use AAA approved

name: Daniel Freer
text: Good people willing to help in emergencies. Never had any issues!

name: Jesse Scott
text: Quick and easy

name: Michael Aaseng
text: Very helpful

name: Amy Stumes
text: Quick, helpful, polite

name: Fam Sleming
text: Fair.

name: xtex 47
text: Terrible service hang up during conversation, wouldn't let me pick the car until tomorrow so they could charge $30 storage fee.

resp.text: Hi There, thank you for your honest review. We apologize that you had a not so great experience with Eastgate Towing & Storage Inc. We hope that we can make up for it in the future!

name: Katherine Christensen
text: Order boneless and traditional. Traditional were not cooked fully and still pink and bloody. It was almost 10 pm so instead of remaking, we just finished them off in the oven.

name: Lorri Mertens
text: Decent service but my friend got boneless wings instead of bone in. Nachos were good but not much for topping. Don’t think I’ll order them again. Pineapple Ale was delicious!

name: Sinplicity x
text: Went on a Wednesday.  Bottom less wings and fries. Food was perfect. Drinks were cold and It wasn't busy. Very clean establishment lots of TV options to watch. Fast service friendly staff. Will go again....!

name: Donna Moeller
text: I had chicken wrap with chips and salsa. Was very good. The service was great. The host was going on to  Sit us  by a large group of people, ask if we could sit at a different table so we got different table. That was only problem we had. As it was that table was loud we can hear them way over at our table but it all worked out fine.

name: wade herrmann
text: Good food and quick service. Their new boneless wings are better than the old but, their prices are still high for what you recieve. Also if you have a favorite sauce you can buy it and take it home with you which is a nice option.

name: Tyler Casanova
text: Extremely slow service. Took my card to pay and after 40 minutes had to chase a waitress down to get my card back only to find out my card had been ran already they just never brought it to my table. Definitely didn't tip. Food was good otherwise.

name: Ronald Rousseau
text: This location isn’t even open.

resp.text: Hey Ronald. Thanks for letting us know about this, we are very sorry. Please fill out the form at the bottom of BuffaloWildWings.com/FAQ where it says 'Orders & Visits' if you don’t mind so we can get some more info.

name: Chris R
text: Good buffalo wild wings definitely a little small. Would recommend going at non-peak hours because other then how busy they get they're an amazing place to have a meal or some brews.

name: Mike Esping
text: Wednesday October 2nd I tried calling 3 times to order take out, all 3 times I was put on hold to never get answered again. One of the people who answered was named Ashley. In the 20 minutes I sat on hold, I made it to the store, thought I'd take a picture just to show how "busy" this place was. Maybe I should've placed an online order. OH WAIT! That's not possible either. Theres no way this location survives. I gave it a one star because zero isn't possible. Honestly, BB's bar and grill hands down beats these wings by a mile, they will be my go to from now on.

name: Patrick Olfert
text: Boneless wings used to be so good, but they were kinda dry. Waitress was on top of it and did a great job though. This place is too busy sometimes :p

name: Mila H
text: Ordered boneless wings, ceasar side salad and a drink, the garlic bread that came with the salad was extremely salty! My wings were lukewarm and a little dry so I sent them back only to have them returned to me cold and covered in more sauce. The salad was good 👌 drink was strong, other than that I was not satisfied with the meal. Our server was friendly, informative and patient as we had a few questions, I'll give her 5 stars

name: Ken Carlson
text: Nice clean place to eat. The music was a little bit loud for me for a noon time meal. Service was great as was the food.

name: Daryl McCormick
text: 4 of us were seated and had to wait about 15 to get drinks another 10 minutes went by before we were asked what we would like to order. 35 minutes go by and then we get our food with no silverware. Another 10 minutes and then we finally get our silverware to eat cold wings with little to no sauce on them. Took us another 25 minutes just to pay so we could finally leave the place. The manager that night around 9 PM at night was not friendly and did not care about us. Never going back there again. It's literally wings and sauce is all we ordered and they couldn't even get it right.

name: Teresa Strohfus
text:
Food was cold, took over 25 minutes to get our drinks and there was no one there they were not busy. Waiter Michael was awesome. We go there allot with our co workers but we are done.
Hope it gets better

name: Voon Wong
text: Good selection for  lunch. I had the Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich, it has just the right amount of heat to make me sweat. If you like spicy food, this is the sandwich for you!

name: Mark Javers
text: I had the Caribbean Jerk and Thai Curry wings of which both were very good. The o service was good. The only thing was that it took a long time for our food to come after the order was placed, but the Farm Show was going on at the time so that may have been a factor.

name: J D
text: Online order didn’t go to the right store despite selecting many times. They fixed and the “remake” took around 40 minutes. Not the end of the world but also not exactly impressive. The food was luke warm by the time I got to my car. I’ll skip takeout from here for a while.

name: Kevin Lopez
text: Wings and sports! Fantastic. Service is hit and miss but overall this is a decent place to have wings and a beer. TVs everywhere with outdoor seating. I enjoy the seasonal wing options as it is always nice to mix it up. AZIAN ZING!!!!!!

name: Foxx Valentine
text: Time after time the quality and service just continues to go down.  No matter which of the 3 sioux falls locations I go to, it the same barley mediocre food and service.  For more than $1 a wing, youd think you could get better than this.  Thanks for the thimbles worth of blue cheese dressing and 4 sticks of celery  for a 15 piece order.  I do believe this will be the absolute last time this place gets my hard earned money.  They just can't ever seem to get an order correct, I ordered 3 different sauces and only got 2 sauces and one of those was wrong, that's 33% in my book and certainly deserve better than that.

name: Abby Marshall
text: Excellent service! The staff is kind and very accommodating. I had a great experience here and 10/10 would recommend!

name: Kenny Richard
text: Nice restaurant with decent parking around the establishment. Near the freeway for easy access. Two levels with lots of seating. Tons of TVs in a typical buffalo wild wings atmosphere.  Good service and family oriented.

name: Knocksteady
text: It was very slow, took almost 10 mins to get a seat. Then we waited and no one came to check on us. Felt very under staffed, and it want no where near busy.

name: Noel Kruse
text: Took 5 minutes to even see an employee when we got there. There were only 4 other tables with people there and a total of three waiters. Got seated and ordered drinks but took 10 mins to get them. We ordered our appetizer at the same time, but didn't get that until 25 mins later when we got our food - asked for it before our food. The app came out cold like it had been sitting for a long time. We sent it back and never got a new one. After 30 minutes of eating our main course, we just told the waitress nevermind on the appetizer. Husband also got a Budweiser instead of a Bud Light. Would not recommend.

name: Velva Retzlaff
text: Ate Saturday nite Oct. 26th and the Food was Excellent! Our cook was James Johnston and his cooking is out of this world. Also the have the best cheese curds in SD!!

name: Abigail Colby
text: A family favorite dining destination! Nobody in town beats BWW boneless wings. I usually order from the same few sauces and am never disappointed! Staff is always friendly and checks appropriately during dining in.

name: Brandi Monroe
text: took a 20 min to get someone to come to our table! and after we had to wait for them to get our ticket!!! Check on your people more! I love the food why we choose you for our lunch dates. Our Anniversary lunch and we chose you!!

name: Will Griffco Recover
text: Its been awhile since I stopped in here. I always enjoy myself when stopping in here. I like the different promotions they do.

name: Benjeman Meyer
text: Worst experience. I've tried all sioux falls locations lately. Horrible service from all. After an hour of waiting my family decided to leave. We had not received our food or beverages. If you have toddlers you know this is not okay. We did however have the wrong order delivered to our table. I'm giving up on Buffalo wild wings. I can't believe they get a crowd when the service is so horrible. Do I just have bad luck? I can't believe that when it's something EVERY TIME.

name: liza Knappe
text: Food was good but had to wait a bit to get it and they weren't even very busy. People that came in after us got their food before we did.

name: Betty Erickson
text: The service is fine. I like that they are busy enough that the wait staff isn’t dropping by every couple of minutes. My fiancee and I don’t care for the food (I don’t eat wings and he says theirs aren’t very good), so we only go maybe once or twice a year when we can’t get his football game at home. The drinks are usually very good and the place stays reasonably clean.

name: Kristy C
text: Good constant food. We have always struggled with the wait staff but when we get what we order (and drink refills), it is good

name: Christopher Veiga
text:
It's like a sadder Sickies.

But hey, at least you get half off boneless or traditional on certain days

Also why are there so many babies in BDubs when I go? Do babies love wings that much? Seems dangerous, unless it's boneless. Maybe they like the carrots and celery.

Anyways I always order ahead and everyone looks at me in amazement when I just pick up my food during the dinner rush.

ORDER ONLINE YOU PLEEBS.

name: Ryan
text: Great place to go hang out, eat some wings and watch a game. So many big flat screens and projectors it felt like every game that was being televised was on one of those screens

name: Corey Erickson
text: Weekdays over lunch isn't too busy.  Always great food!  The waiter kept our drinks full and was making sure we were having a great experience.

name: Ricky Robinson
text: Tuesday nights are great night buy 10 get 10 free

name: Donald Ohmann
text: Amazing amazing amazing!!! Great setting amazing food try the onion rings for sure or the street tacos!!! Great service too!

name: Lance Gushwa
text: Service has greatly declined in the past 6 months. As I write this I still have not received food in almost an hour. I'd ask for a manager but I don't think one is around with the way this place is going. I wouldn't want a free meal if they offered it I'm tired of giving this place second chances. I'm done.

name: Marcella Suter
text: The wings were great and the waitress was too.

name: James Girard
text: BWW is the premier sports bar for football fans!  Love it!

name: Alcoa S
text: Wings were five star.  Sat at the bar for the better part of 20 minutes before asked for my order.  Even tha manager stared right at me and pretended I wasn't there.  Asked if they could turn on soccer game but instead they changed a summer league basketball game to a 2004 MLB all star game.  Lame location.

name: Brian Wilson
text: Want tv and dinners, sports sports sports.... nuff said and wings.

name: Tommy Wendt
text: I had never been to Buffalo Wild Wings until last Saturday we stopped there for lunch... we had some time to kill between matches we were playing in a pool tournament nearby and the guy that I went there with had eaten there before so I asked him what to get and he said he was going to order the boneless chicken wings.. I got a large order of parmesan garlic boneless wings and when they came I was impressed with the size of the order there were enough pieces there for two people... the waiter was polite and friendly and the service was very good but I was definitely extremely disappointed with the food... the chicken was very heavily breaded I couldn't taste the chicken at all... for a place that specializes in wings they had no idea what a good boneless chicken wing should taste like... if I ever go back there again I'll buy the bone-in wings and we'll see what happens then... till then the jury is still out

resp.text: Hey Tommy. We apologize for the poor experience you had with us. Please give us a call at 866-704-0777.

name: Paula Marshall
text: The staff was great and attentive.  The food arrived promptly and was delicious!

name: Amber Whitmore
text: The last few times we came to BWWs, our service was quite disappointing, but tonight they have redeemed themselves. Our server, Amanda, was amazing. She was very attentive and friendly. She has a southern accent that is very endearing and has the warm demeanor to match!

name: Noah Ebel
text: Got a really good discount on a Wednesday and both my girlfriend and I were able to get unlimited wings for around $15 for both of us. This was a welcome surprise, and the food was good.

name: Paul Meyers
text: Overall was good. Reservation for 25 people was forgotten, so high tables were not available as requested and appetizers as requested was never provided. The food, however, was great. I had mango habenero wings, with side of beer battered onion rings. The place was also a bit on the warm side (before my wings).

name: Ben J
text: They were beyond busy and I was  able to sit and order and eat in under 20 minutes. I had a fantastic burger and was overall impressed.

name: Rachel Radack
text: Our wings were luke warm,  server checked with us half way thru so we didn't want any fresh ones.  Never offered a discount so we had to ask then the manager came over discounted our ticket never apologized, printed it off and left on printer and walked right by us like we were an inconvenience and went back to whatever he was doing.  We waited for about 5 minutes for ticket.  The waitress was like did he not give you your ticket.  I said no he was rude and walked away after printing it.  We will never go back there again.

name: Alan Carter
text: It was a slow night but service has been great. True test of a place is when it's slow, if they can do it then, easy bet on a busy night, auto pilot. Well done Dani and the rest of the BW's crew well done!

name: Aaron Erickson
text:
This is the worst place in town. I've been over an hour only have my beer.  Seen my waitress 2 twice. And it is nowhere near busy.  How is place still in  business

Update: 1 and half hours later food came wings were warm at best

Never coming here again

name: Samuel Everist
text: Super common food place. Very popular, so usually it is packed full. Service is decent. Would give more stars, but I have gotten cold food here before and a snarky waitress to go along with it.

name: Mike
text: This location is very slow and overly strict on how many wings you can or must order at one time. Other locations are wonderful sadly this one is the closest to my work

name: Christiaan de Klerk
text: Walked out after not getting any service. Used to be great but clearly gone down hill.

name: barb zirpel
text: Great food. The service was awesome 😀

name: Wendy Hedeen
text: Because everytime I go there something gets messed up. Like today a co worker asked for a well done hamburger and it was medium rare. And my chicken ceasar salad was not and half of the lettuce was bad. Went back for my ceasar and got a garden again. So if you don't care how your food comes out you will be ok.

name: Zack Allen
text: This is actually one of my favorite places to eat. But I have to say that they got rid of alot of good deals that kept me.coming back.over the years, but if they dont bring back buy 1 burger get half off or buy 1 get 1 then unfortunately will lose my buisness.

name: Zach VR
text: Great place to eat. The service is really awesome. There is waitress/bar tender named Ashley who does a really great job taking care of her customers. Love this place.

name: a google user
text: Food was good as expected. Service not so much.

name: Leilih Smart
text: Great food! Great service!

name: friendalot67
text: Delicious wings great service and overall fantasticly flavored sauces

name: Adriana
text: Great food! I recommend the cheesecurds.

name: Joann Preheim
text: Food was good staff really friendly was my first time here will go again

name: Jordan Decker
text: Food is good. Service is very slow though. Probably understaffed.

name: Kristen Cross
text: I like this one because it's never too crowded. The waitstaff is great. They always remember what my husband and I like to drink. They take care of you without being too pushy. Always have a good experience at this location.

name: Gary Miller
text: Beer was nice and cold Ashley  was great

name: Zeke Hanson
text: Easy location by the Convention center for a quick bite before or after an event.  Great service. Reliable menu. You know what your getting at BWW.  Of all the options in that area, this is the best one.

name: Michael scott
text: Great food, fun environment, but the food takes forever to come.

name: Moises Madrigal Zamora
text: Great place to watch a game. Great wings good beer.

name: Randy R
text: Personal preference: wings weren't saucy enough but I also didnt ask for them to be.  My bad. In for lunch with 2 co workers. Pop and order taking happened quickly but food took a while. Wings were warm enough but could have been hotter. Average experience.

name: Jim Sislo
text: Really good service at this location.  I have been to several of these and by far the service here is the best plus PBR on tap.

name: Jessica Riesselman
text: Food came out luke warm. Our waitress was friendly, but she had too many tables, so it took forever to get drinks.

name: Jason
text: Great place to get with friends and have a few drinks.  Excellent wings too.

name: Nairellim
text: Spent a grand total of 25 minutes at a table when they weren't all that busy and not a soul said anything to me or my girlfriend. We were essentially forgotten about. Eventually a waitress did show up and took our order. It was a Wednesday so we wanted the all you can eat wings. We ordered it and she looked at us like I was trying to explain particle physics to her. It didn't take long to get our food so I tried to get a reorder of parm garlic wings and 5 minutes later I received a little container of parmesan garlic sauce. No wings, just the sauce. I say something and after waiting another 10 minutes or so I resigned myself to the fact that I won't get them. This was the worst experience I've ever had at a BWW.

name: Chase Esslinger
text: Restaurant was essentially empty and it took over an hour to get dinner and a beer. Service was terrible, and they got our order wrong. I would never recommend this location to anyone.

resp.text: Hey Chase.  We are very sorry about the poor experience you had with us.  Give us a call at 866-704-0777 if you don’t mind.

name: Brian Bonnema
text: Pretty good food, but the manager here does not honor BWW deals advertised for Sioux Falls, which is pretty dumb for a BWW in Sioux Falls.

name: Scroll Pirate
text: Loud. But as thats an obvious complaint I'm rating it on the other issue. We constantly had to wave down a server for anything and everything. To order we waited around trying to wave down people.

name: Austin Unseld
text: Very well run BWW. Relatively busy but quick seating in the bar area. Good service

name: Heather Rensch
text: I wish there was a zero star button. My server HATES her job. I had to go to the bar to get my table of 8 drinks. Had to ask a manger to take a food order for 4 people. This is all after waiting 40 mins. She's rolled her eyes on several occasions, pointed and laughed at me when I had to ask the bartender for drinks. Cleaned off the 4 tables around us without prebussing our table even once. This is a table with bartenders, too bad hun, you could have  had a $100 just for smiling. VALLIE find a job you like.

resp.text: Hey Heather. We are very sorry about the poor experience you had with us. Please give us a call at 866-704-0777.

name: Brad Lewis
text: My girlfriend and I usually go to the Louise location as it's more accessible. But, we were on the other side of town and stopped in for wing Wednesday. To start, the service was horrible. We were there for almost 30 minutes before we even saw our server walk by. And then almost another 30 before we got our first order of wings. I think in total, our server came to the table 3 times in the almost 2 hours we were there. All of our re orders had to be relayed through a separate server. Normally, we don't leave reviews. But this was absolutely the worst service that either of us has received, ever. Probably the biggest waste of $40+ at a restaurant that we normally love. We will not be returning to this location.

name: Jordan Hewlett
text:
Would give zero stars if possible.
Waited 10 minutes before wait staff even acknowledged our existence. Our waitress was incredibly rude. After waiting another 10 minuets, we ordered..then waited..and waited. I finally had to walk to the greeters and ask for them to check on our food. It came out shortly after that COLD. Not luke warm, COLD. We complained and after 10 minutes we had our order. Only once in our hour and a half lunch did we get drink refills. Very disappointed, as a customer who takes clients to varius BWW locations I will for sure not be bringing any to this location. I will be following up this review with a phone call to the manager.

name: LINE-X of Sioux Falls
text: Love me some B-Dubs!

name: sivart namdoog
text: Not the best atmosphere..but naked chicken tenders were good.

name: Jason Glaesemann
text:
The food was awesome.  The parmesan garlic wings are one of the best items on the menu in my opinion.  I enjoyed eating them along with the potato wedges.  But that's where the positive experience ended.

Granted, we were a rather large party of 30+.  I am sure that was part of the trouble.  My party of 2 arrived a little bit behind everyone else.  I guess the organizer of the party tried to call ahead but was told that they don't do reservations.  This is fine and I do not have a problem with this but, when the people of our party showed up, the hosts we're annoyed she didn't call ahead.

The service wasn't steller either.  Granted, there was one waitress covering us and a couple of other tables.  Refills were non-existent.  I also had to ask for silverware and our dipping sauce.  In addition, we had to order twice because the first order got lost or something.  The funny thing is that when the server was handing out the bills, she forgot about us.  She only realized we didn't have them until after everyone else had paid and starting to leave.

I would save some of the headache and just order to go.

name: Brad Harner
text: Food was good.   Wait staff continues to plague this restaurant.   Not very motivated

name: Bobbie Kelly
text: We ordered two appetizers one appetizer came right away and the other one took about 25 minutes. Our food took over 45 minutes to come and wasn't very warm and one person's didn't come for at least 15 more minutes. It wasn't even very busy when we got there.

name: Shokora Valkyr
text: BWW has awesome atmosphere and good apps, I like the drinks too.

name: Josh S
text: It had been a while since my last visit. It was a good reminder why this is the location I perfer. It's out of the way, the crowd was small, and the servers are bubbly.

name: Christopher Coatney
text: Food was great but served had a attitude

name: B Bowah
text: Loved the bar area, and enjoyed the UFC game...the food (Ice Cream) I had was good stuff.

name: Shanna Walker
text: Yummy and very kind staff . Takes a while though

name: Eric Krueger
text: Real lit but really cold. The air came on y'all. It's January. Turn up the heat? Otherwise love the place.

name: Taylor Hiester
text: Surprised this chain can stay open. This branch lives up to the terrible reputation for food quality.

name: Michael Kotzea
text: Great service and plenty of TVs!

name: Dug Thompson
text: Great tasting wings (I did the blazin challenge), fast service, nice employees :)

name: Brian K
text: Food is good, but service almost always sucks during lunch(even not during lunch its below average). I would think a place that is open for lunch would know that people have an hour lunch and would strive to get people in and out in under an hour(for drive time).  NOPE not this place. text: FYI... this is long...Absolutely terrible!!! We love bdubs, but this is our third bad experience there and is the icing on the cake. Started off with our waitress Kiera( i think that was her name, she didn't introduce herself). She came to our table obviously in a bad mood stating the kitchen was behind and food would take about 30 minutes. We decided not a big deal and to go ahead and put in our order for an appetizer and a kids Corndog meal for our daughter right away asking that they be delivered together. Then about 5 minutes later ordered mine and my husband's meal. About 20 minutes passed and our appetizer arrives. The onion rings are burnt and the food is Luke warm at best. We blow it off. The waitress comes over about 5 min later and we bring up that our daughter's food was supposed to come with the appetizer. She says she will check on it. We also ask if the TV can be changed to a fight that my husband wanted to watch. 15-20 minutes after our food arrives. (The TV never got changed). My husband's wings are hot which is good, my daughters corn dog meal is Luke warm, and my chicken tenders are actually cold. We send them back. At this point I order a blended margarita and so does my husband.  Manager comes over and says he will come them and will have another order out in 5-10. Another 15 minutes go by... chicken comes out cold AGAIN. Also my drink came out on the rocks rather then blended. I still drank it. We kept trying to get our waitress or managers attention all night and we were ignored. At one point our waitress had a friend sitting at the table right next to our booth and sat and talked to her WHILE IGNORING US. NO JOKE!! Finally the bill is brought and my meal hadn't been taken off(it is still on the table untouched). We ask to see the manager. The waitress returns and tells us he just wrote $30 off but won't be coming to the table. Great. Whatever. I have never been so disappointed in a restaurant.  What gets me about the entire experience is A) the waitress was so incredibly rude the entire time. We were nice throughout the entire experience. She acted like she was too good to help us and just wanted us to leave from the very beginning. And B) the manager. He never came back to check on my meal. He forgot to write it off after he said he would. And then rather then coming to our table when we requested to speak with him, he played the coward and just wrote off some of our bill. We are not mean people! We weren't even angry. Just disappointed and wanted to share our experience so this could be avoided in the future. We stilled tipped. We understand that life happens. It was busy and the kitchen was backed up. It happens. The food came out and everyone was too busy to get it. We understand.  What killed all of this was the customer service. We will never go again.

name: Chuanpit Moser
text:
This review is specific to Costco tire services we received today 3/2/21 around noon. I have been going there for tire services for many years. I have bought 12 tires there. I take each car in twice a year to switch between regular and winter tires. I went in to change from winter to regular tires today because the weather is in the 50s going on to the 60s. It took 1 1/2 hours. Rob Fitzpatrick reprimanded me for coming in for tire change “prematurely.” His tone suggested that he was upset with my decision. Then he told me that a TPMS battery was low and a warning light might go off tomorrow or, in a year. He checked my car out. When I got home I noticed an obvious leaking sound on a tire so I drove back to Costco. John McGaugh confirmed that a tire nozzle was loose and leaking. (No leakage prior to tire change.) John fixed it. I have received services from John and other staff (among them Henry Goodman I think) many times and never had any problems. I conclude that Rob is NOT professional while John is. How could Rob check out a car with obviously loose and leaking tire nozzle? I might not go back to Costco next winter unless I can specify which mechanic I do or don’t want work on my car. I have noticed Michelin medals or awards displayed on the wall. Please award John. He is the competent one, not Rob.
UPDATE on 3/3/21: Went in for 25-mile safety check today. Rob offered an explanation and an apology for the event yesterday. He provided a good service today. I appreciate that Costco and Rob took notice of my feedback and took action to improve our relationship. Therefore, I am adding 2 stars to the 1 star I originally gave.

I feel like they really excel at electronics, home and kitchen supplies, meat, and frozen food. The meat selection is always top notch and is great to use half and freeze the rest. The fresh vegetables are hit or miss. Some are good but you have to pick through a few packages to find them. I find more than not, I end up throwing away lots of vegetables because you get so many. In the end, they are still sometimes the best deal to buy compared to other places even if you throw out half because they're so cheap.

The employees and customer service here are the best and is where they really set themselves apart from the competition. Everyone is always friendly and they recognize you from previous visits. The return policy is to do whatever they have to in order to make you happy. Some people take advantage of this but for the rest of us, it's nice to know it's there when you need it.
