text: Mostly good, the selection was okay and so is the quality. Check out service was very good, but then I was told I needed to stop at customer service to verify my address. The same one for the last 28 years.... but whatever, right? So I stop there, wait a good 15 minutes, and tell the lady what I'm there for. She tells me my address, which is correct, but then says the "problem" is that they don't have my driver's license on file... um, no? I ask why that would be necessary, and she tells me that without it, I can't write checks, and it would be easier to return my membership card if it goes missing. I work in banking, and have learned from experience not to house sensitive identification information in any more places then necessary. I mean, I think we've all heard the many stories in the news about major companies getting hacked because they were housing demographic and identifying information that the bad guys wanted to mine and sell... So, I decline. I tell her it's okay, I don't want to write checks there anyway, and will be sure to provide it to them if I change my mind. That's when the gal gets condescending, taking a tone, and asking me if there's any particular reason why I don't want to provide it... like I'm a criminal for not giving it to her... I just tell her I work in risk management and don't think it's wise. Funny thing to be personally offended about. But hey, maybe she just really believes in the technical protection prowess of Costco. In any case, the moral of the story is, no, you do not have to allow Costco to retain your driver's license number in their system to maintain your membership. Just say no!

name: Tim Farnsworth
text:
I have a Sams Club membership and a Costco membership.
Reason I have the Costco membership is because of a good deal for the year , so I am pretty new to Costco.
Have been a member of Sam's Club for years.

Recently I spent 3 hours in both stores comparing prices with both and noticed that while there are various selections in both stores, there similar items are priced about the same + or - a penny or so.

Having said that there is one thing that really bothered me when going through Costco.
I was looking for some common items that we use regularly.

Eggs. Only cage free at higher price.
Milk. Some odd shape square jug same price as Sam's
Potato chips. Not Available.
Tator Tots. Not Available.
Iceberg lettuce. No Romain or Iceberg lettuce.
Tortilla wraps or soft shells. Only one kind at one size.

There are other items but this gives the general idea.

It is true that they have about 50% Organic stuff. (Will exclude personal opinion)

Costco is NOT business friendly, they do not open there doors until 10 AM.
Were as Sam's Opens there doors at 8:30 for Businesses.
Most of the items are geared to consumers.

They also do NOT take credit cards, unless American Express. (This would make sense to keep costs down, but why does Sam's accept them and keep the costs the same).

The ONLY reason I can think to use Costco is there nice travel discounts if Executive member, that Sam's has discontinued (for the most part)

Over all I will not be going out of my way to go to Costco.

(Original)
El Verbos Saludos!

name: B W
text: For the price you pay to eat a meal here, everything should be top notch. The drink I ordered was not good and my entree I could tell had been sitting under a heating lamp for a long time because the food was just warm and the plate was very hot. The food is however very good, loved the Lobster Mac my wife ordered and their sushi is great.

name: Mr. Leon
text: The best service we've ever had , food was very tasty and worth the money. Our server (Oliver) was the best server we've ever had. He was genuine not just working for $. Talk to the manager about about how awesome he is and she wants to take him back to MN lol

name: Jordan Waldner
text: One of the nicest if not the nicest restaurant in downtown area. Food is great. Takes awhile to get your food but that's expected since it's a higher end restaurant. Definitely recommended.   (King Kong sushi and lobster mac and cheese)

name: Annie Drayton
text: First of all, I must say that whoever ever named the place, nailed it!!! My sister and I came from  from California to visit our brother. Our hotel was across from Crave so we decided to take our niece there for an early dinner. I had made reservations online, which was very easy to do. We were seated right away and our waiter showed up immediately and took our orders for drinks. He was very attentive and made several suggestions about the different beverages available. Our drinks were perfect ! My sister ordered the gluten free Crave burger and my niece ordered a  chicken sandwich.  I ordered something I thought was very unusual.  It was the lobster mac and cheese with a side dish of grilled shrimps. Our meal was served in record time. I have never held back my opinion on how good or bad a meal was. I have to say not only was the presentation of the food  good, the flavor did not, in any way, disappoint!  The cost of the meal was extremely reasonable.  All in all, the place is elegant but we didn't feel underdressed because of our casual clothes.  When I return for another visit to Sioux Falls it won't matter how near or far my hotel is from Crave, I will definitely dine there again!!!

name: James White
text: This isn't based on the food it's based on customer service. The first time my wife and I ate there the food was excellent and the service good last night we called and asked about a table, we didn't have a reservation but my wife loves a particular pasta dish they have so we thought we'd give it a shot. We were asked when we were coming and we said right now, we were in the car and moving, the young man on the phone told us if we came before 6 we'd be ok but after 6 we'd have to wait or have a reservation. We arrived at 5:45 and were told they had just changed their policy or some such thing and that if a table opened up we might be able to be seated. Now since we were the only people standing there and I could see empty tables it was a little irritating. In summation, food, good, service, less than desirable. If you're not interested in taking walk ins just say that so I don't waste my time or yours.

name: Bobby Hegge
text:
I'd give it 5 but for the following::

sashimi you can read a newspaper through ...just skimpy for the price unless you like to read the newspaper thru your sashimi I guess.
Do you know how much salmon sashimi you can get at sushi masa for what I paid?

Service: slow.
and I had to clear my own table twice-- still tipped her 20% out of conscience but still unacceptable. So that was 20$ as our total bill for: appetizer, 3 drinks, a burger and pasta was 100$

The drinks were good and my entree was tasty... shrimp scallops pasta I'd return for! Just cook the pasta right next time
Good luck.

name: Melissa Prostrollo
text: Tables are nicely spaced for a feeling of adequate distance but you can still see everyone else's food going by, to get ideas.... We had their burger battle burger which was very creative and fun. They also have really excellent fries, especially with the aoli. Yep, that's the stuff. The sushi and cocktails are also signatures and are always beautifully presented and delicious. I have never had an unpleasant server at this location. They are always friendly and accommodating.

name: Michael Anderson
text: Not bad, seemed like a lot of spicy stuff which I don't have tolerance built up for, but it was pretty good.

name: Kelly Commet
text: A most 'do' experience if you are in Sioux Falls. Everything was amazing!

name: Lisa Serck
text: Received the wrong order.  Had to wait for the correct one.  The test of my party was done eating.  Good food.  Got an apology only.  Feel a reduction in the bill was in order but wasn't offered.

name: darren hengeveld
text: Great food with a nice atmosphere. Friendly staff. Will be going back soon!

name: Elijah Stoesz
text: Our waiter was quite friendly and was helpful with providing details on varying vegan needs and requests.

name: kyle kirby
text: Great sushi. Pricy but a good indulgence

name: Cathy Morris
text: Upscale yet casual dining. They have a fantastic sushi menu as well as a unique American menu. I was visiting from out of town so I ate here twice. I had a fabulous pumpkin ravioli. I also had some chicken avocado egg rolls that I loved! I tried the flirty Martini which had prosciutto and blue cheese stuffed olives. It was delicious, but very rich. Another entree offering was build a bowl. I had a fantastic basmati rice and chicken combo. If you have room, treat yourself to the mini chocolate mousse; to die for. The staff was attentive, friendly and fun. Treat yourself if you're ever in the area.

resp.text: Hi Cathy, thank you so much for dining with us and taking the time to share your kind feedback! Please know that I will share your compliments with our management team and the chef. We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon. Thanks again! ~Melissa

name: Whitney Fowkes
text: Good service and the food is good too! Wait time can be a little long and sometimes they run out of things, but otherwise a very wonderful place to dine.

name: michelle cramer
text: Food was great, service was great.  I wish the host enforced the mask wearing.  Also it this a health code issue ti where her out fit so short.

name: Kim Edblom
text: The food was very delicious, quick seating with a reservation, staff had masks on, the drinks were good but I have had better for the price.

name: Udale Batie
text: My pineapple mojito was good but it had a little too much ginger, staff offered to replace it and I said it was not necessary and just added more pineapple to counter the spice from the ginger. The food was EXCELLENT. Unfortunately my kiddo found a hair in the last of her lobster Mac n cheese. thanks

name: SD_Me
text: The sushi rolls at Crave are amazing! The Godzilla roll is my fave, and the spicy shrimp appetizer in the Siracha sauce, mouth-watering and nice kick! Had dinner with friends out on the patio and it’s a great, open setting on the river, so nice for laughing loudly and enjoying food and drinks with friends and family. Loved those rolls so much that we ordered out for delivery during this time of quarantine and got quick delivery. Tastes just like if I was sitting at the restaurant, same quality. The chopped salad with roasted chicken is tasty too, delicious!

name: Annamarie Jakos
text: I loved the variety of food that was available. I had a sushi California roll and a Crave burger. Both were delicious. I sat at the bar with a friend and it was quite comfortable being there. The bartenders were knowledgeable and efficient. The place was clean and people seemed to respect each other. I definitely would go here again and try their outside seating.

name: Renee Decker
text: Loved the food, every dish we ordered was delicious especially there sushi. Gje only down side was it took a long time to get our food.

name: Shannon Kubik
text: Absolutely one of the cleanest well organized restaurants in town whether it's take out or dine in

name: Ewald Van Der Helm
text: Trendy restaurant and bar with vegan and vegetarian options. You can get past the waiting lines by sitting at the bar.

name: Matt Woll
text: Sushi is top notch. Godzilla roll and King Kong. I try to order sushi if I think a restaurant seems like they know what they're doing. You will not be disappointed with their dishes. Very good.

name: Daryl Wagner
text: My wife and I both enjoyed our steaks. The cake and tort dessert duo was also a hit for a Valentine's Day dinner. Our server Angela did a wonderful job and was very pleasant.

resp.text: Hi Daryl, Thank you so much for the kind review. We look forward to having you dine with us again soon! ~Melissa

name: Leah Moody
text: We tried so many great meal items. The tomato basil pesto soup was amazing. We really enjoyed the chicken stir-fry, dragon sushi roll, and chicken caprese rosa as well. Loved the atmosphere and quiet location.

name: Shelby Klein
text: The food was amazing at every level. We did a sushi appetizer and a steak dinner. We ordered rareband medium rare steaks and they were cooked perfectly. Scallop sides which were also delicious. We each tried 2 different adult beverages and our server knew exactly what to reccomend.

resp.text: Hi Shelby, Thank you so much for your kind feedback! We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon. ~Melissa

name: Josh Perry
text: So the atmosphere is all right but we ate 2 dry and over cooked burgers plus 4 beers and the total was $70 before tip.  If that's your thing than go for it but there's way better options out there.

name: Jackie Robinson
text: Good food, great view (if you get a window or outside seat).and the sparkling sake was great! And all of the waitresses recommendations from the mocktails to the entree were on point.

resp.text: Hi Jackie, thank you so much for dining with us and taking the time to share your feedback! Please know that I will share your compliments with our management team and the chef. We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon. Thanks again! ~Melissa

name: Austin Day
text: Were out of 2 food items and 2 drinks we wanted. Had to find other choices. Buffalo burger was lacking flavor and was a total grease mess. Patty wouldn't even hold together. Side of jalapeno was pickled vs the fresh that was on the sushi. Strange.

name: Chris B
text:
Awesome food and great service!  Their menu has enough of a variety to appeal to many tastes.  I'm not a big sushi fan but their Bamboo Bite Rolls are absolutely incredible!

We went through a few times a row of missed/wrong orders but they always correct it and we haven't had that happen for a while.  I wish parking was a bit better but at least the ramp has plenty of it.

Overall, if you want a unique experience without spending a ton of money, these guys will fit the bill.

name: E.M. Olsen
text: Best sushi in town! Their drink select is always top notch. Located downtown on the river green right on the bike trail. They have a great patio over looking the Sioux River. Great date night location as one can enjoy downtown and the river green afterwards.

name: Jen Bates
text: Best Sushi in town! Everytime I'm in Sioux Falls,  we stop here & they NEVER DISAPPOINT!!

name: Nicole Wyatt
text: Great experience, even during lunch. Wonderful sushi and seafood dishes. Our waitress was extremely sweet. This restaurant was a needed splurge for us!

resp.text: Hi Nicole, Thank you so much for the kind review. We look forward to having you dine with us again soon! ~Melissa

name: Reece Chambers
text: One of my favorite places in Sioux Falls to eat! Great food and good atmosphere with a river view. The Godzilla and Mexican sushi rolls are my go-to's but I have also had the fish tacos, which were also good. I would warn that, although the patio has the view, it can get a bit warm at times. This is due to facing southwest, minimal shade, and glass panels that block any breeze that is present.

name: Brad Hearst
text: Crave is a fantastic restaurant offering a wide variety of options. I specifically enjoy several of their sushi rolls. The Bamboo Bite and Mexican Roll offer a nice spice and flavor. The Godzilla roll is delicious as well. With every meal there are hot towels and bread as well. Tucked right off the river during summer Crave offers a prime patio location. Stop by and check it out for yourself.

name: S C
text: Atmosphere and waiter was excellent.  Seafood paella was lukewarm.  Dynamite roll was excellent.  A little overpriced but glad we tried it.

resp.text:

Please know we take comments like yours to heart and will be sharing this with our management team and chef. Will you please email me at your earliest convenience so I can personally help resolve the issue for you? Please email me at kylie@kaskaidhospitality.com, I look forward to connecting.

Thank you,
Kylie

name: Trent Dalle
text: Great food pretty pricey, but only 3 burger options 🤷‍♂️

name: Ashley Hintz
text: Every server I've had has been fantastic.  I'd rate the food an 8 and the service a 10.  Great atmosphere and location.

name: Lynn Flores
text:
Excellent food....the sushi is the best in Sioux Falls and the service was  more then what we expected.
The. Service was right on.
Thank you

name: Patrick B
text: Good food and great drinks. Very knowledgeable staff that are very willing to help. I recommend this place, but not if you're on a budget. It isn't super cheap.

name: Abeni Kester
text: Great atmosphere and even better food. I highly recommend the CRAVE Burger - which came with a huge amount of fries. I also tried the mini tiramisu, and that was also really good. It reminded me of the dessert shooters Applebee's has.

name: Bryan P
text: Great service great food.

name: Sara Weinreis
text: Really great selection and service - I recommend the rainbow roll. Always have a good tap beer list, too!

name: Justin Lamkin
text: Graet food great service

name: Kris Johnson
text: Food was excellent, as was service.  Went to celebrate a friend's birthday.  Had sushi.  Sat on the patio.  Carry out available

name: Rachel Iverson
text: The best sushi I’ve had, and I’ve eaten a lot of sushi! Better than the rolls I’ve had in Seattle, Denver or Portland, how is that possible?? Great selection of quality upscale food. We manage to spend around $80 on 2 meals a dessert and one drink, so it’s not an everyday place for us. I would recommend this place to family, friends and strangers. We will have to visit the city again to eat here 😋

resp.text:
Hi Rachel,
Thank you so much for dining with us and taking the time to share your feedback! Please know that I will share your compliments with our management team and the chef. We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon.
Thanks again,
Melissa

name: Pauline West
text: After a couple of trips to Sioux City, Crave has emerged as my favourite and go-to restaurant. Was dubious about the sushi dishes but was ordered by the table during business dinner and pleasantly surprised. Seems understandably busy with a good ambience and each dish that we tried was good or occasionally great.Really enjoy my visits here. Everything tastes so fresh & staff seems to enjoy environment. I love what they’ve done with the remodel! Lemon Garlic chicken was excellent & friends raves about the Bamboo Bite & Aloha Roll.

resp.text:
Hi Pauline, Thank you so much for dining with us and taking the time to share your feedback! We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon.
~Melissa

name: Madeline Koch
text: Went for a birthday dinner and it was great! I'm not a fan of sushi, but everyone else said it was delicious. The chicken stir fry was super good as well as the baked crab &  artichoke dip! Highly recommend both. They were pretty busy so it took a little time to get the order, but it was worth the wait! The portions were on the smaller side being a fancier place. We finished the night with a brownie topped with ice cream and whipping that had a sparkler on top!

name: Miguel Washington
text: Really enjoy my visits here. Everything tastes so fresh & staff seems to enjoy environment. I love what they’ve done with the remodel! Lemon Garlic chicken was excellent & friends raves about the Bamboo Bite & Aloha Roll. After a couple of trips to Sioux City, Crave has emerged as my favourite and go-to restaurant. Was dubious about the sushi dishes but was ordered by the table during business dinner and pleasantly surprised. Seems understandably busy with a good ambience and each dish that we tried was good or occasionally great. If you love to be on the river - this is the place. The food is good. Bar has a great wine selection. Can get very noisy, but manageable.

resp.text: Hi Miguel, Thank you so much for your kind feedback! We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon. ~Melissa

name: Kandice K
text: My husband and I went here for our 31st anniversary. We started at the bar where the bartenders were very nice and the drinks were great. We were seated right at our reservation time.   Our food was SO good! Yum! We had a wonderful time and I can't wait to go back!!

name: Alex Roki
text: Excellent food and superb service, the servers are well educated and they treat everyone with love and respect, I will return if I ever visit Sioux Falls again

name: Peter Cobb
text:
This Sunday 7/5 was my third visit to Crave.  And while our hostess visit wasn't thrilling, our server and meal made up for it.  Best food I've had out of my three visits.  I apologize in advance for the long review!

A little back story on this third visit.  We had a reservation for 6:30 and we made it exactly on time.  However there was some confusion (on our side) with our party, I thought they had checked in, the other side of the party thought we had checked in.  My wife's parents were staying at the hotel above crave and I assumed the reservation was under their name.  We have a newborn who needed changing and we were having trouble finding a bathroom with a changing table (don't use the bathroom in the hotel lobby for baby changing, use the one at the entrance of crave.)  Wife and I just got married and because of covid, our parents hadn't met one another yet.

Long story short when we were finally ready to sit down about 15-20 minutes after our 6:30pm reservation, the hostess, rather rudely, informed us we were late and we would have to wait.  Waiting was not the issue, and we were mortified we hadn't properly checked in, but just the sense of being punished by the hostess was very off putting. I own a restaurant and my staff would never be so disrespectful to customers, and believe me people are frequently late for reservations!  Furthermore, the table they sat us in was empty the entire time we waited, so not like they didn't have space to seat us, not to mention there were 3 six tops in area they sat us all clean and unoccupied (6 of us plus infant.)  I thought maybe they were social distancing, but both other six tops were seated about halfway through our meal.  Simply put, we were being punished for being late!  Can you tell I'm still annoyed!?

The entire meal was a success and our server, Ezra, (I hope I spelled it right!) was phenomenal.  Very knowledgeable of the entire menu, including the cocktails.  If we didn't live so far away, I would totally have offered her a position at our restaurant!! (Just kidding Crave, you have yourselves a solid team member.)

The sircaha soy edamame and tempura jalapeno bites were great.  I had a huge platter of sashimi and everything was very fresh.  I ordered another round of salmon and it was like butter!  Wife was very happy with her salad and our parents really seemed to enjoy their meals. We ordered dessert, tiramisu, French chocolate silk, and coconut cake all of which were very good.  Also, bartender(s) made a solid gin and tonic for me.  And all other mixed drinks got verbal compliments from theirs drinkers.

That said, we left a little bitter with the reception we received.  Very important that greeters maintain a welcoming aura, as they are the first and last folks you see when you dine out.  There were no smiles, no welcomes and a very condescending tone and that's just not right!  However, we will be back!

name: Don Hansen
text: Good food, great service. Has something for everyone...

name: Candace Briscoe
text: The greatest place. Truffle fries, surf and turf sushi.  Omg

name: Alex R
text: I'm a huge fan of CRAVE and always have excellent food, drinks, and service when I visit. I love the patio along the bike trail and the outdoor bar is a fun spot for some summer day drinks. Last time I ate here a few weeks ago I had the Tropical Poke Bowl and my boyfriend had the Filet Mignon and we both agreed that they were the best Poke Bowl and Filet Mignon we have ever had at a restaurant. He had some fish tacos as an appetizer and said they were awesome.  The drinks were awesome too... I had a seasonal cocktail (I think it was a Mail Tai) and he had a Bloody Mary and both were super good.

name: Allen Sarutzki
text: Great food, great service.

name: shawn o15
text: Great service! Fantastic food! Good location and atmosphere! Highly recommend this place for a casual comfortable experience with a modern twist on food and drinks. You wont be disappointed. Thanks again!

name: Aaron Laake
text: Pricey.  Food was good.   Great cocktails.

name: Trevor Bunde
text: Great sushi awesome service. Would recommend!

name: Launa Heinemeyer
text: Food is amazing, service is a little slow

name: Chris Cardozo
text: My wife and I went for happy hour. The drinks were great. Thank you Connor. We had appertizers...a variety and all amazing. Sushi, flat bread pizza chicken wraps. A place to go back to again.

name: roman craigle
text: Love the sushi, Meryll the bartender is amazing!

name: Alvin Carlton Jr
text: Excelent food.

name: Jacob Whalen
text: This is a pretty nice restaurant, I'm not a huge fan of the steak that they booked, but the other food they have is really good. Would recommend if you're looking for a nice place to eat. There is some beautifully scenery around the restaurant as it's right by the river. Because of that it has a pretty nice patio to sit on and enjoy your meal or a drink.

resp.text:
Jacob, thank you so much for dining with CRAVE and taking the time to share your feedback about the steak and for sharing your kind words about our food and atmosphere! We're so glad you love the scenery as much as we do! We hope to see you again soon.
Kylie

name: Zach Megill
text:
Update: the burger menu is a big step above the sushi menu. +1 star.

Neither the quality or quantity match the price. It reminds me of an overpriced airport restaurant.
You would go here if you where staying in the hotel, but it's not worth coming here with the expectation of getting full.

name: Jeffrey Pay
text: Went there for lunch.  Not busy, service was timely, staff courteous,  and ouf order was accurate with customization.  The do offer surveys that save you $5 on next visit, and they allow a good amount of time to come back.

name: Rob N
text: Good food, great environment

name: Jennifer Brindley
text: What a great stop on our trip! Delicious vegetarian sushi. We ordered a bowl as well but they forgot the grain element we selected and when they brought it to us after we asked, it was incorrect. However it was still delicious. A little pricey but the environment / ambiance is nice and a pre or post dinner walk on the riverwalk is wonderful. Also they have a little section on the drinks menu for virgin cocktails and the cucumber ginger beer one is delicious!

resp.text: Hi Jennifer, thank you so much for your feedback! I will share this with our management team - it is feedback like yours that helps us improve. I sincerely apologize for the mix up with the grain! We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we look forward to seeing you again soon. ~Melissa

name: Mark Kozel
text: Awesome waitress. Really enjoyed sitting outside watching the people walk by.

name: Leah Kent
text: Two starters, two cocktails and two entrees (1of which was actually chosen from the starters menu) for $75 not including the tip.  That's a little pricey but it was a celebration dinner so I planned on a bit of a splurge.  BUT, the service was average - one of starters didn't come right away and the server blamed the kitchen...however when we did get the parmesan fries they were lukewarm.  They are probably good if served hot.  The California roll was bland, the soy sauce very salty but not rich tasting.  I had the Seafood Paella which was also bland and greasy - pooling in the plate greasy.  The shrimp was good, the sausage and chicken while spicy lacked any depth of flavor.  Quite sure the risotto was microwaved as it had very hot and cool spots.  Overall, not too impressed.

resp.text:
Leah, I wanted to personally reach out and apologize for your dining experience and meal. Please know we take comments like yours to heart and will be sharing this with our management team and chef. I’m truly sorry you were disappointed! Will you please email me at your earliest convenience so I can personally help resolve the issue for you? Please email me at kylie@kaskaidhospitality.com, I look forward to connecting.
Thank you,
Kylie

name: Rachel Fortney
text:
Update: * * * * We went back a second time and were very pleased with our experience, so I'm raising my review to 4 stars, but because we went during the day and didn't go to the bar we couldn't duplicate our experience. However, I plan to come back and I'm hoping future experiences will raise my rating to 5 Stars.

* * * A bad experience from the start. The lazy, young hosts at the front had no interest in doing their jobs. Not friendly and completely forgot about seating us. The bartender acted like his job was a nuisance. Unfriendly and rude. We were incredibly unimpressed from the start. I expect more from a place like this. The only thing that saved the experience was really good food and an excellent server who was very friendly and attentive.

resp.text:

Please email me at kylie@kaskaidhospitality.com, I look forward to connecting.

Thank you,

Kylie

name: Obiwan K-no-bee
text: Atmosphere is wonderful, for being a hotel lobby restaurant. Bartenders were great, helped with drink choices and answered questions. Food was delicious, had the Argentine ribeye and Chilean sea bass. The guacamole mashed potatoes were the star of the ribeye dish for me. The mushrooms were the star of the sea bass dish for my wife. We are ready to go back and try more dishes!!

name: Brian Stormo
text:
Crave is very hit or miss food-wise. The nachos are good, the burgers are fairly mediocre (the bun is too big and dry to be good), steak is sometimes great sometimes luke warm, same with the fries. The sushi is consistently good.

The beer selection is good. The patio is great. The bar staff is great.

resp.text: Hi Brian- Thank you so much for dining with us and taking the time to share your kind feedback! We are so glad you enjoyed your meal and we hope to see you again soon. ~Melissa

name: Seth Tornow
text: Good food, good drinks. Chic, trendy atmosphere. Crab topped sirloin with mashed potatoes and asparagus is killer. The bartender we had while waiting for a table made a great Old Fashioned.

resp.text: Hi Seth, Thank you so  much for dining with us. Please come back and join us again soon! ~Melissa

name: Ner Ner
text: Busy, noisy place located inside a hotel.  Not bad, but not amazing.  Had the seafood paella which had little relation to a real paella but it was tasty.  My dining partner had the Argentine Steak which was good, but not great for the price point.  Drinks were strong and the waiter was very friendly.  The location is very nice and it would be a nice place for drinks in the patio when the weather improves.

resp.text:
Ner Ner, I would like to thank you for dining at CRAVE and taking the time to share your feedback. We set high standards for quality and I am so sincerely sorry that we let you down. Will you please email me at your earliest convenience so I can learn more? I look forward to connecting.
Thank you,
Melissa (melissa@craveamerica.com)

name: Jade
text:
Absolutely ~LOVE~ that they have so many vegan options!!!!!

CRAVE recently brought down their prices on their vegan options and use super high quality ingredients. They source their vegan cheese and meats from the Herbivorous Butcher based in Minneapolis and their products are fantastic!! Love all the vegan options they offer some of my favorites are the Impossible Burgers, Vegan Nachos, and the Caprese Flatbread. I do wish they added more vegan cheese to the nachos but that’s my only complaint. Service is pretty mixed depending on who you get. Overall, fantastic food and definitely need to stop in!

PS. Don’t get the vegan cake it’s not that great... (Mind improving on your cake CRAVE?? Also please add more vegan cheese when you give out nachos and the flatbread ❤️❤️❤️)

name: Dominic Mickelson
text: Good variety of food.  Although on the higher end of menu pricing.   Very loud in the building and lots of echoing.   The price point I would expect better service.   Lots of reaching across the table and not proper service.   Old fashioned was very good.   Food was good, but not outstanding in any way.

resp.text:
Hi Dominic-  Thank you for dining with us and taking the time to share your feedback. We set high standards for our restaurant and I am so sincerely sorry that we let you down. Will you please email me at your earliest convenience so I can learn more? I look forward to connecting.
Thank you, Melissa (Melissa@CRAVEamerica.com)

name: Mr G
text: Food was Tasty, well prepared n very fresh

name: Dusty Rallis
text: Nice atmosphere. If you like sushi a good place to eat if you're looking for something else to eat the macaroni is  an option.

name: Karen Seeman
text: Food is tasty, service was prompt

name: Private Reviewer
text: Food was ok, but the real issue was service!  Staff was friendly, but they must have been overwhelmed or under-staffed during my visit.  This place has great overall potential and likely rightfully very popular.  Better service would have taken this review to 5 stars.  Again, staff was friendly when engaged, but didn't check on the table.

name: Voon Wong
text: This is a wonderful place for an elegant dinner, especially when you are celebrating your wedding anniversary. Perfect meal, perfect service.

text: Stayed at the hotel next door and was told to check out this connected restaurant. What a nice surprise Crave is an upscale bistro with a great menu. I had the soup of the day creamy asparagus soup which was very good. I decided on the lamb burger as I liked the concept. It had some Asian spices and was served in a naan bread. It was by far the best lamb burger I have ever had, just the right amount of heat and a complex melody of flavors including cumin, fennel, pico de Gallo and Greek yogurt. 10 craft beers on tap and large ice cube for the nightcap cocktails. The restaurant is located on the Missouri river and has a nice patio. Will try and return in the summer. Definitely worth a visit.

name: Josh Flory
text:
Ate on a Tuesday night.  Long waits after seated for drinks then appetizers.   Several of our table's orders were incorrect and two had to send their medium well steaks back as they were bloody raw.  The appetizers were good as was my salmon, but most of our party felt it was just "so so".  Very attractive atmosphere, crisp clear lines, fun architecture.  However, the seating felt very open and exposed.  Perhaps some dividers or natural barriers would help.  Staff was very friendly and corrected issues with steaks but overall it made it a below average experience for a restaurant of what should have been a higher caliber.

Desserts menu's descriptions misled a few as well, would benefit if they had a dessert cart or photos of each of their offerings.

The service used to be mediocre at best which really killed the vibe of the place. BUT, we were just there on Monday yesterday and the service was exceptional. So good that i deleted my first review and i'm submititng this one instead. From the hostess to my server. I think they finally got it right. If they maintain the level of service, this restaurant should be around for many years to come.

name: Chris Trefz
text: The decor is smart. The patio seating is perfect spot to have a great lunch and grab a bloody mary or one of the many craft beer options. I was able to try the Cuban and the grilled chicken, apple, and brie sandwhich. The Cuban could have been made by Jon Favreau himself(That means I liked it). The chicken, apple, and brie had a great aioli the tied it all together. The chicken was perfect, which is a rarity these days. Really moist, high quality slightly blackened on naan with some arugula, apple, and brie. The fries are also really good. I look forward to checking out the Asian side of the menu in the future. The inner seating is still a somewhat awkward setup being in the hotel lobby so I'm not sure if I will come back much in the winter.

text:
I quit going to Hobby Lobby because of some of the issues I have with the store and staff, but I went to their new location 2 times to give it another shot.

I find it difficult to find things because of the layout of the store. Aisles run different directions around the outside edges of the store, and the middle of the store is a mess of aisles and displays.

For a craft store, I find their selection of fabric to be lacking. It's an extremely simple selection that I would expect to find in the WalMart craft section.

It is super hard to find any staff if I need help finding something or have a question. In such a confusing layout they really need to have a better guide system or have more staff walking around.

The staff at the fabric counter are slow and inefficient every single time I've bought fabric here. They take a frustratingly long time helping each customer, and they have to write the ticket by hand. This means they have to write the price of each cut of fabric, write the sale price of each cut if its on sale, then total it all up on a calculator.

The checkout is equally as inefficient as the fabric counter. Prices are typed into the register by hand, any sale prices are typed in manually, then coupons are entered by hand.

Hobby Lobby seems like a great store for framing, home decor, floral crafts, jewelry making, and kids crafts. However, for fabric and string crafts I will always go to a competitor because of their lack of selection and their super slow systems. Factor in the awful layout and not being able to get help, and I will probably not go back here for awhile.

name: Annie Drayton
text: This was a real treat for me! I was visiting Sioux Falls to spend time with my family. They told me they were taking me someplace that had a variety of delicious foods. They were not wrong! The selection of the many  self-serve items was wonderfully overwhelming! I mean there was just about any food you can think of at a reasonable price! I chose my main meal to be at the Hibachi Grill. I chose what meats and/ or veggies I wanted and watched  the chef work his magic! It didn't disappoint. Of course I had to sample various other dishes.  YUM!!!

resp.text: Annie, family really knows how to pick out the good stuff! It makes our day to see your eyes light up after gazing at our buffet of delicious food. When you're in town again, we hope you'll be by for more. - The Hibachi Team

name: mandy west
text: Food is good and service is good, but they give you the cheapest plastic silverware they could find, no knives either. And everything is on Styrofoam plates. Ice cream used to be big containers of different flavors, now its tiny individual cups of vanilla or chocolate.  A little disappointing. Please get better plastic ware to use and provide plastic knifes as well.

resp.text: Mandy, next time, feel free to ask for additional silverware! We're more than happy to provide them to you. Thanks for raising your needs. -The Hibachi Team

name: Operation Freedom Van
text:
This experience was just okay. We brought a service animal in with us and she left with something sticky all over her fur. Whatever was on the carpet ended up all over her.

Everything is on styrofoam plates, cups and bowls. The food was just okay. The sushi was probably the best part of the buffet line.

A note on the staff - I don't think anyone speaks English here. There was a gentleman in the buffet area looking for silverware. Several employees were attempting to have a conversation with him but he couldn't understand. I let him know that his plastic-ware was probably left on the table by his hostess. Pretty awkward interaction with the staff. Later I asked for a receipt to be reprinted but the waitress took it out of the trash. I asked again and she looked at me confused. See the photo for a better understanding.

I put up a number of pictures which help understand the experience.

resp.text: When guests walk through our doors, we only want them to leave fully satisfied. We understand that the precautions we have to take with dishware is not what everyone would prefer, but the safety of our community overrides our need for glassware. That said, we love to interact with every guest and would be happy to explain that if they wish to ask. Please, join us again! We'd really love another chance to impress you. - The Hibachi Team

name: Karen Seeman
text: So enjoy coconut shrimp.  I always leave so full.  I'm glad that I ate slower than usual.  Its cleaner with the Styrofoam single serve plates and plastic cutlery.  And happy to enjoy a sesame bun.  It was a tasty experience

resp.text: Things get pretty tasty around here, Karen, especially when you go for coconut shrimp! Just the right balance of sweetness deserves to be savored. Come back again soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Jessica Fields
text: It says face mask required and people not even doing that. No gloves for tongs so cross contaminating everything they touching. No social distancing at all, food is good for the most part except for that.

resp.text: Jessica, we appreciate you reaching out with your concerns. If you see a patron or employee not wearing protective gear, please let us know immediately. We do take the safety of our community seriously. Reach out to (605) 335-3388 with the date and time of your visit, and we will ensure this doesn't happen again. - The Hibachi Team

name: Chips Galore
text:
Depending on who you are, this place can be great or terrible.
Personally I've been going here for a long time now, and it's not bad, the sushi's great, the hibachi is fun to watch, and the place is overall pretty good, there's plenty of types of foods here, ranging from pizza to ice cream, and soup, there's a mix of cultures in the food, which is great, but the cleanliness could be improved on, as the tables are rather sticky, and the bathrooms aren't as clean as one would wish them to be, service is overall decent, and the atmosphere is nice, there are things that need improvement, and some things that don't.
(P.S. The styrofoam plates and cups with plastic silverware is for Covid-19 reasons, they had normal plates and cups before all of this, it's best to stay safe.)

resp.text: We can't say enough nice things about regular customers like you, Chip. After trying sushi, hibachi, and other delicious selections of ours, making recommendations should be no problem. With that, we'll be looking into ways we can improve your overall experience. Cleaning and sanitizing restrooms and tables is a chore we never skip out on. The next time you visit, we hope to impress you with a spotless space. Until then! - The Hibachi Team

text: Well, to start off with, the was place was packed, you had to wear mask as well in your booth too. No gloves to wear as you pick your food off court. Services was not good at all and for the price you pay, the food wasn't good.  I got sick after ward's. The quality of the food was not to standards.

resp.text: Firstly, Jay, we hope you feel better soon! We have not had any issues of illness come to our attention. As you mentioned, we do take safety here seriously -- that goes for our food, too! That said, we are willing to look into your concern. Please call (605) 335-3388 with the date and time you visited. We'd love to look into this for you. - The Hibachi Team

name: Heather Sikora
text: It seems to be the place we always go to celebrate, as everyone can typically find something that they like. The variety is okay, there is sushi, a hibachi grill, american and Americanized chinese foods. The taste of the food is not terrible, usually.  Even having a child with egg, peanut, and dairy allergies, we find plenty for her to eat and be happy. The hours may say open until 9:30pm, but we arrived a few minutes after 8pm and a few pans were empty and becoming crusty from staying in the heat. About 8:45 I asked if any of them would be getting replaced, as the items I normally selected had been empty since our arrival, and more had emptied in that time I was told the kitchen said they were out and could not make more of what I wanted.

resp.text: Over all the celebrations, Heather, we've loved serving you and your family the variety you crave. We wish we had everything in stock on this particular night! Many of our guests have go-to selections, and we apologize if we ran out of the items you were looking forward to most! Please, come back again soon. This time, we'll be sure to have all your favorites lined up. - The Hibachi Team

name: C W
text: The food here was half decent Chinese, and the other half tasted funny. The thing that made me leave even though I wasn't done eating was biting into some chicken and scallions and it just tasted off, but the rest of that chicken I had was fine. I suspect now that they have reopened they were mixing old and fresh chicken in to use their stock. The icing on the cake was the stale fortune cookie. Don't go here

resp.text: We're excited to have our doors open again because there's nothing more satisfying than delivering delicious food to the visiting community. We can understand if not every dish in our buffet meets your expectations, but we can assure you that everything we serve is prepared fresh. Let staff know if there's something you don't like in the future -- we are happy to accommodate or make a recommendation. - The Hibachi Team

resp.text: We're so happy to be a part of the restaurants you trust to keep you comfortable during recent changes, Kelly. From our smile to our sanitation process, we are working our hardest to ensure your dining experience is the best that it can be. See you again soon! - The Hibachi Team

name: Scott
text: Staff was rude. We decided to leave instead of eating there and we were followed to the door like we did something wrong. Door says masks required, but when you go in, no customers were wearing them around the buffets.

resp.text: Scott, if our regulations are something you don't agree with, we understand. That said, we stand behind our requirement of wearing masks. - The Hibachi Team

name: Ed Peters
text: Covid-19 safety being followed.

resp.text: Ed, it's so great you could stop by! Come back to see us soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Taylor Dominguez
text: Good food good variety.

resp.text: We appreciate all the support, Taylor! Hoping you'll make it back our way. -The Hibachi Team

name: Debra Deglman
text: Very disappointed,my Mom and I come here each time we visit heart doctor.The food was very mushy,gone to putting more american food out than oriental.

resp.text: After multiple visits, Debra, we were really hoping you and your mother were enjoying your meals. It's unfortunate to hear the selection has been anything but satisfying to you lately. Please don't hesitate to let our employees know if you're looking for a specific dish in the future. We're confident we can bring what you've loved from us in the past back to the table. - The Hibachi Team

name: Daniel Archambeau
text: Awesome food...so much variety to choose from!!

resp.text: We appreciate you swinging by, Daniel! Hope you're able to come back soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Heidi Connor
text:
The service made sure she pointed out the tip part.it was so dirty there was food all over
The  floor and the buffet area .

resp.text: Heidi, we're troubled you have this impression of us -- our team would have been happy to address any issues with our buffet area right away. We're hoping for another opportunity in the future to show you what we're all about. -The Hibachi Team

name: Brett Tedmon
text:
Love the place. Couldn't ask for a better selection of Asian style food. I'm not a raw fish fan but the girl I've been with there say it's quite good. The pick your own ingredients and watch them dry it grill was awesome! I've never had a problem getting more tea or sodas for kids.
I always leave there smiling, stuffed with good food and without a big dent in my wallet.
I recomend it. You won't be disappointed!

name: jorgea MENA
text: Not the very best Chinese restaurant we been to. Food was subpar

resp.text: We appreciate you giving our Chinese food selection time to shine, Jorgea. It's unfortunate you didn't find your serving the best of all time. We hope you come back in the future to give us another shot at impressing you. - The Hibachi Team

name: Jaz Myers
text: I've always had a good experience at this buffet and walked away stuffed silly. I'd love to see coconut chicken on the buffet some time but always find things I enjoy to eat there that are hot and delicious..

resp.text: It's almost funny how many times you can get up for more of your favorites, Jaz! We're grateful to know you love whatever selection of fresh food we put out that day. Be back for more soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Mel Scovel
text:
I don’t get what the bad reviews are all about. My main complaint is the lack of good labeling on what everything is. Other than that it’s just the everyday normal complaints about trying to keep hot food hot without it getting too tough.

Their were plenty of sushi options and had they been labeled I might have been willing to try more, but the tuna roll was pretty good. I really enjoyed the lemon pepper wings those were mighty tasty.

name: JP M
text: Much better than 2 years ago. Food out on buffet that needed to be hot was much better than last visit. I tried the sushi and unfortunately very dry and little flavor. Service was quick friendly and helpful.

name: Michael Lustfield
text: The number of different foods served and the variety is impressive and kind of absurd. Unfortunately, this place is very much quantity over quality. The sushi bar usually serves a couple nice rolls and some of the other dishes served are good. The rest is really only appropriate for when you're just looking to pile a lot of random stuff into your talking hole. It's at least priced appropriately. If it weren't for the wait staff, this could probably be four stars.

name: christina minor
text: Absolutely great food.

name: Brad Ringgaard
text: Food has gone downhill.

resp.text: Brad, in what ways can we make your experience with our food more enjoyable? Please let us know and we'd be more than happy to assist you. -The Hibachi Team

name: Isaac Heuer
text: Our family favorite.  Largest buffet around, and at a decent price.  Definitely American-Chinese style foods only. A fair sized sushi bar and a Hibachi grill.  The hibachi grill is far from the fanciest, but good food comes off the line if you build your plate right.

name: bryan wilson
text: Good food big variety but a little pricey

resp.text: Bryan, thanks for the great review! Hoping you'll come back soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Karin Wells
text: My family and I visited right before Covid really hit and places started shutting down. We had just recently moved to Sioux Falls. Had seen a lot of advertising about this place so we thought we would check it out. It was seriously gross. It smelled bad in there, was humid and dark and didn't seem clean. Everything had a greasy film. Food was at best bland and some was just vile. I'm 51 and we eat out, well, probably too much, but this was one of the worst places we've been.

resp.text: Although we're really disappointed in the way you describe your visit, Karin, we hope you've been back over the past months. In comparison to your review, our freshly presented selection has impressed many in the community! We can't speak for your experience in the past, but we'd love to know what you think of our place now. Please, consider joining us again sometime. - The Hibachi Team

name: T Lee Daniels
text: Always fresh good seafood

resp.text: We're really glad you could visit us! Hope you'll make it back our way soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Shannon Arnao
text:
I DO NOT RECOMMEND! UNCLEAN & HAVE COCKROACHES!!!
My daughter and I we're filling up our plates. After a gentleman put a new serving of crab Rangoon out my daughter said she saw a bug in the pan. I asked her are you sure? Long story short. It was a  cockroach!!!  I let one of the staff members know. He grabbed the pan and the cockroach and said Okay I get you new ones and walked in the back. After telling a staff member in the front I grabbed my daughter and my son and left.

name: Ronald Webb
text: Food was good service was okay

resp.text: Ronald, thank you for your feedback! We're confident we can provide service that makes you just as happy as the food. Come back soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Phil Troy George
text: Great food and service

resp.text: Phil, we're glad you had a good visit! Hoping you make it back our way soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: CJ Prudhom
text: Great selection. Everything was hot and fresh. Great array of delicious sushi. Ate more than I really wanted. Couldn't stop!

resp.text: After the first bite, CJ, you probably won't put down your food for a while! We're glad you waddled to the door as full on sushi as you ever want to be. Hope you'll be back for more fresh selection soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Foxx Valentine
text: I mean for $13, what do you expect?  It's mostly fresh hot food with a pretty large variety although most of it is filler and chicken.  Because of the steam table buffet lines, it tends to get a bit hot in there.  I'm not exactly sure what these people are expecting a tip for though.  It is what it is and worth the trip if your hungry or need to satisfy a bunch of people as the variety is quite extensive.

name: Nikki Anderson
text: Must of went at the wrong time even stayed longer and alot was empty

resp.text: We're sorry to see you weren't entirely impressed with your experience, Nikki. We wish we would've shown you a more enjoyable meal this time. Hopefully, you'd consider giving us another try sometime soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Julia Eagle Star
text: Food was great, but not good social distancing tactics, need to space people apart

resp.text: Julia, we do our best to keep guests at a distance. If there was a situation where you felt uncomfortable at all, please don't hesitate to let us know immediately. Your safety is our priority -- we'll do everything possible to ensure you feel right at home. - The Hibachi Team

name: Jonathan Busch
text: The food all tasted the same. I was really disappointed  and probably will not return again.

resp.text: We really hope you'll reconsider joining us, Jonathan! With a buffet available, we're sure there's something that would cure your craving for savory or sweet. See you again soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: tigger Inyou
text: Love the food love the service everything was wonderful

resp.text: Tigger, a great dining experience has more than one special thing about it. We're happy to make sure everything shines when you're here. Come back soon for some fresh favorites. - The Hibachi Team

name: Tammy Somnis
text: It was not as good as it used to be not sure y but when I had the cook cook my food my noodles were so hard got another same thing that they need to fix. I got there all the time

name: Waunita Denney
text: Good food , social distancing seating, sanitizer through out restaurant

resp.text: Waunita, we're so happy you could swing by! Hoping to see you back our way again soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Black hills metal buyers
text: Was kinda worried about going to a buffet on a weekday at 2pm but this place knocked it out of the park. Food was all very fresh and selection is HUGE

name: Tonya Tonjhè Sandidge
text: I love the variety of food. The staff is always pleasant and it's always a pleasant dining experience.

name: Joe Beaudoin
text: You can eat your face off and get nice and full don't get me wrong I enjoyed it. However, there are so many items that it is darn near impossible to feel any "love" in one particular entree and it is not perfected in the sense that you crave a single individual dish. However, They do a very good job keeping things full and fresh and it is acceptable quality. They should let you pour your own sauces like hu hot does at the hibachi grill by the way. I wanted mine spicy and it was nowhere near spicy because they pour it on.

name: Michael Stoops
text: So I popped in at 2:20 in the afternoon the total came to$19 and some odd because its price by the wait I asked if I could also get some sweet and sour sauce to go with the two dinners and she hands me a 2oz portion cup and I asked I just got twenty bucks worth of food in your going to give me to oz of sweet and sour sauce for a tall I walked away one got my sweet and sour I found some other portion cup so I filled up for more total of five she expected me to pay for them luckily the nice house behind mrs. Know so that comes with your dinner so I handed her a 5 right in front of the lady

name: E.M. Olsen
text: Huge buffet selection and grill centrally located in Sioux Falls. The food is present well and everything was neat and clean. A lot of the food is fried, but there is a salad bar for lighter options. Nice experience I would go again. It is just not a wow experience to get 5 stars.

name: Curious 921
text: A very nice place to eat. A ton of choices for food and many deserts. The food is very good and choices. There is even a chocolate fountain and kids will love all the choices for dessert.

name: Stadiume Hott
text: Left me a bit disappointed. Huuuuuge selection of food, but nothing left my taste buds tickled. Nice venue though, conveniently located. The service is very low key. I do recommend you check it out, they have something for everyone. But nothing made me crave coming back more often. Which is is usually my baseline for a good restaurant.

name: Katrina Cordell
text: I have never had good experiences here. It's a great idea for a buffet but I wish the quality of the food and service were better. I found a fake nail in my food once and I haven't went back since. The food is always overdone or underdone and I don't feel comfortable eating something that makes me think I will be sick afterwards. Don't recommend. If they changed some of their regulations up a bit and put some effort into the restaurant it could be great but as of right now it just isn't good at all.

name: Sioux Falls Santa
text: They are open and they are conscience of the need for cautions with the health issues. The food was as good as ever.

resp.text: Walking through our doors, Sioux, you can rely on an enjoyable experience. Precautions are taken daily, and we're happy to know you feel safe in the environment we created for you. Hope you will be back to visit again soon! - The Hibachi Team

name: Justin Breems
text: Good variety. I like the many options of sushi rolls. Hot food was ok.

name: Scott Dougherty
text: I love Hibachi Grill. great choices of entrees. Awesome location,  friendly servers, and great value.   Be careful too not over eat as tetras so many choices of great food.

name: Brad Franken
text: Good food, very busy at times.

resp.text: We appreciate this excellent review, Brad! Looking forward to seeing you back again. -The Hibachi Team

name: David Nichols
text: Good service and price... Substandard food (not dangerous but inconsistently bland to uninspired)

name: Shandi Demps
text: Good food

resp.text: Shandi, we're glad you visited us! Hoping you're able to come back our way soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Julius Yonly
text: Perfect place

resp.text: We're really happy you could stop by, Julius! Hope you make it back again. -The Hibachi Team

name: Erik Braley
text: so good! really good place to eat. Don't think I've had a bad experience here

name: Russell Hotchkiss
text: Great food

resp.text: Really appreciate the review, Russell! Be sure to come back our way again. -The Hibachi Team

name: shawn dukes
text: Good food

resp.text: We're really glad you joined us, Shawn! Hoping to see you whenever you're around. -The Hibachi Team

name: M L
text: Disappointing experience, quality and taste were lacking, not like it used to be. Crab Rangoon recipe was off and we used to love them here. Food was full, serving utensils needed to be washed. Pepper chicken was chewy, prime rib and beef w/peppers and onions were both tough. Not sure that we'll go back.

name: Tanner Terrio
text: They have good food, staff and space. The wait may take a bit but that depends how busy it is. They take your drink order then you go eat. It's a buffet by the way.

name: kayla marvin
text: Safe distancing great staff

resp.text: We're really happy you enjoyed visiting us, Kayla! We hope we'll see you soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Nicole Hansen
text: Nice clean restaurant. Food was hot n fresh! Large variety to choose from!

name: Brady Olson
text: So much food to choose from!  You will find something that hits the spot!  Sushi, to hibachi grill, to pizza and Mac and cheese, to loads of Chinese dishes all on the buffet.  Reasonably priced as well!

name: Jana Cook
text: Made me sick after eating there.

resp.text: Jana, have you spoken with us directly? If not, please call (605) 335-3388 with the date, time, and dish you ate. Although no other incidences of illness have been brought to our attention, we are determined to investigate for you! We hope you feel better soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Donia Rattei
text: First time eating here. Wow they have everything to choose from. Was AMAZING. Will be coming back

name: Chad Zephier
text: If you walk away hungry, stick with McDonald's. Always busy. Great eats!

name: Luke Skinner
text: I really like hibachi, and this is the best I've had in South Dakota. Everything is fresh, and the food from the buffet is rotated regularly. The price per person is also very reasonable, and the staff is friendly and attentive. This is definitely someplace to eat when you're in Sioux Falls if you like Chinese food.

name: Tim J
text: I was amazed at the different all the different type of food they have. You would think how can they do so many types of food and still be fantastic. They do it very well. I have never had a bad experience with Hibachi grill and Supreme Buffet. Nice environment and clean. A  great  restaurant for a meal with a friend or the whole family.

name: John Small
text: Too good! We love to go here.... but I always eat too much! ;-)

name: Danni Burchardi
text: By far the greatest buffet I have ever been to! The most fantastic variety I have ever seen. They have American, Chinese, Japanese and many others with variations of each. Great dessert bar and salad bar! I would recommend this place above all others! The price is very reasonable. It doesn't matter if you go by yourself, as a couple or a big party. It was our 1st visit there with a large wedding party and it was great for all! We will be steady customers every chance we get. Great place to take the whole family! Whatever your taste, you will find it here!

name: Dakota Sparks
text: Normally this is a good restaurant but this visit was really hard to swallow. The hibachi meat was definitely sitting out far too long and was as dry as shoe leather. Then when we went to hit the sushi bar, the man behind the counter was picking his nose right over the food. I hope that this place can get it's act together because otherwise they have been serviceable

name: Jeff
text: Plenty to choose from. Sushi bar has some good varieties. Have not tried the hibachi part, have heard it is good. Service is prompt and kind.

name: Ruben Gonzalez
text: Nice buffet

resp.text: Thanks for the excellent review, Ruben! We hope you'll make it back our way again soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Brittany Schultz
text: So much great food here its hard not to stuff yourself.  Lots of things to try and lots of things to enjoy.  It also has a relaxing seating area for dining.  Great place up eat if you don't want to wait long to get your food.

name: Lisa Roman
text: If I could give zero Stars I would this place was horrible there were flies all over the food and everything seemed old

name: leslie Greybuffalo
text: Awesome choice of Chinese food, such wide variety of dishes too please even for most hard to please. Although price is not the most modest especially when you have to pay more for your leftovers that you take home. Other than that you do leave the place full to the brim. Ho ho ho.

name: Paresh Wagh
text: Food lovers...Just go and enjoy...Really awesome variety !!! You can even customize your Habachi grill and it's included in the Buffet. There were 200+ items in Buffet. How often you see that in Buffet!!!  Price was good too. Good place to enjoy the food with family. It was full of people with less or no wait time. Make sure call them before if you are group of 10+ people.

name: Richard Estes
text: This place offers a wide variety of foods at an affordable price for all you can eat. What a deal! But, if you are looking for good quality Asian foods, look elsewhere. Keep in mind, "you get what you pay for". For what a meal here cost you, you barely make your contribution toward the overhead and food cost so of course you will not get top quality anything. That said, you should expect that food safety concerns are being addressed. I found that hot food were just tepid and cold foods (sushi) were room temperature.  Service amounted to clearing empties but never refreshing beverages and serving the bill while at the same time the server asking if they may keep the change. The seating package is impressive and appears to belong in a high end Asian restaurant rather than an all you can eat buffet. The entrance is equally impressive but that is where the warm fuzzy feeling ends as you step into the chaotic environment of the feeding frenzy of the Supreme Buffet.

name: Levi Aesoph
text: This is a crazy place, so many food options and an amazing variety. I have gone a few times and my only complaint is that the crowd of people who go here make the whole experience seem sketchy. Kids sticking their faces in the chocolate fountain, people digging coins out of the water feature, people pushing to get to the crab legs first.... It can be a bit.... Honky tonk.

name: Oliver Puppel
text: Very good mix of Chinese and American food. For non-Chinese eaters, there are mozzarella sticks, pizza, roast beef, corn, and a lot of other "safe" foods. The Chinese is very good, I usually have some of both.

name: Karmen B
text: Always great food for the price. Staff isn't the friendliest

name: Aidan McBob
text: I went there with my family and we all ate until we were stuffed and they was all very good food

name: Smiley Dls
text: I'm in love with the food

resp.text: We appreciate you taking a moment to show your support! Hope you'll be back. -The Hibachi Team

name: Matt Grev
text: WOW.  This buffet is one of the best I have been to anywhere, not just in Sioux Falls.  There are about 10 buffet tables, including a salad and cold bar, multiple food tables, and an ice cream table with 8 (?) kinds of ice cream.  On top of that, there's a huge sushi table, and a hibachi grill that has a large assortment of items.  The hibachi grill also has both dry and wet sauce options for your creation. If that wasn't enough there is a CHOCOLATE FOUNTAIN with items you can dip in chocolate. The hibachi grill really shines in my opinion, lots of options and the ability to make a truly unique taste experience.  I tried to sample almost everything in the buffet area.  Made my own hibachi creation.  Then I got some mint chocolate chip and chocolate ice cream and dipped some wafers in the chocolate fountain.   It was the perfect finale to my meal and very excessive.  the downside is that I ate way too much food.

name: Andrea Crayne
text: We loved this place. Just moved here and went for supper as too tired to cook. Great selection, hot food and friendly staff! We will be back!

name: jajohnson7809
text: The chicken wings were flavorless and tough.  Not good at all.  The fried breaded shrimp was greasy, and lacking flavor as well.  Everything else tasted fine.  Alot of variety, which is much appreciated.  The servers were pretty good about checking in on me.  The building itself is very nice.  Not the cheapest buffet, but still reasonable.

name: Frank Buffalo
text: Awesome food!! I ate so much, wonderful staff.

name: Veronica Brockman
text: It was great as always. We started taking our granddaughter there 9 years ago. And she still says it's her favorite place to rest!

name: Barry Paugh
text: Ok food and service. Really clean for a buffet place.

name: Beatrice Rosenau
text: Awesome food 👍👍

resp.text: We're grateful for this review, Beatrice! We hope you come back our way soon. - The Hibachi Team

name: Eric Rudberg
text: It's ok, nothing special.  It's what you would expect on at a Chinese buffet.

name: Pattie Woodward
text: We ate here tonight for a birthday supper. The food was okay... mostly bland with very little seasoning. What ruined it for me was that everytime I would walk by the very visible server station/ kitchen area just west of the buffet you could see the area was filthy! Trash and food bits on the floor that stayed in the exact same spaces the whole time we eye there. To top it off, when i tried to get dessert at the chocolate fountain it looked filthy at the table it stood on. There was hardened chocolate all over the unused skewers and chocolate all over the stand too. You couldn't put your plate down without it landing in a chocolate puddle. Definitely won't be back until they clean up in there! With as slow as it was, there's no excuse for that kind of mess!

name: Krissy Schaeffer
text: Love this place one of our best places to eat when we come to Sioux falls. A lot of food for a good price. Would recommend this place to eat.

name: KrazyMexican 7o7
text: Best asain all you can eat in town. Cozy and has food for everyone to enjoy.

name: Judy King
text: It is a wonderful place to eat

resp.text: Thanks for taking a moment to show your support, Judy! We hope you're able to come back again soon. -The Hibachi Team

name: Riaz Khan
text:
Variety of menu: 5/5, if not more than 5
Taste of food: 4.5/5
Environment: 4/5, I found it a little noisy every time I visited
Service: 4.5/5

Overall: 4.5

This is great place. Tons of items. You will never be bored. Variety of Sushi available. Good for meat lovers, sea food lovers and vegetarians. They will cook your customized dish with selected spices and sauce instantly. Lot of desserts. Only thing I miss the the fish items. Usually there is one fish menu and that is great.

name: C
text: Really good food. A little higher priced but good selection. Strang and unique selection but nonetheless.  Eat slow so you can get your monies worth!!!.

name: Will Clipp
text: Awesome buffet and sushi!

resp.text: Will, we're grateful for all the support! Hoping to see you again. -The Hibachi Team

name: Joel Leusink
text:
Great food options, and food is good.
Price is high for a China buffet, but the great food makes this place a reasonable value.

name: Chris Wetrich
text: Always delicious

resp.text: Chris, we're happy you could visit us! Hope to have you back our way. - The Hibachi Team

name: pepe lepone
text: It is probably the best Chinese-style food buffet in the city and there is not only Chinese food, there is more variety, sometimes the waiters look a bit irritable but overall good! 😉

name: Kevon Ross
text: Very good food...I'm not too big on buffet's though.

name: wayne Fetters
text: Great place to eat. hot food

name: Stephanie-Jane Findlay
text: Great food.. I can easily consume three plates.. Highly recommended

name: Umang Selokar
text: Nice place to eat anf you can grab all variety of cuisine.

name: Daniel Bartell
text: The food here is typical for its fare, and does not have much to set it apart from other restaurants aside from quantity.  It is a good place to eat on occasion and is always clean.

name: Jacks Repair
text: I always eat too much when I go there really good place

name: Chris Connell
text: Visiting from out of town and found this place through their website. They advertise themselves as being the largest buffet in South Dakota. However the food leaves a lot to be desired. Their sushi selections look nothing like what they have on their website. In fact their website is a huge miss- representation of what they actually have in the restaurant. This restaurant is nothing more than your average Chinese buffet.

name: JEFF SORENSON
text: Awesome

resp.text: Jeff, thank you for stopping in! We hope we'll see you back our way. -The Hibachi Team

name: Da Champ323
text: Lots of choices or build your own on the hibachi grill.What more could you ask for?  Plus veteran/military discount.

name: joshua coil
text: Decently priced for the selection of food provided.  Fast and respectful service. Its definitely a re-visit family location for us.

name: Terence C. Mournet
text:
Lots and lots of food. Quantity over quality for the most part. Food is generally ok, but nothing to get excited over. Their sushi buffet contains a variety of selections but their rolls are mostly rice with only a small amount of fish inside.

The main buffet has many selections including seafood, chicken, and beef. Good variety- although many of the dishes begin to taste the same after a while. The overall seasoning seems to be similar across their selections. The selection doesn't change in the 10-15 times I have visited.

If you want an authentic Asian experience and intimate atmosphere then try something else. Otherwise, a good place to eat if you value quantity and variety over quality and atmosphere.

name: nathan dahl
text: It's a very large Buffet food is kept fresh and warm. Many of the dishes are of very high quality.   Whereas some of them are not. Service staff is very friendly. The kids love the koi pond

name: J S
text: I love the large selection.  They are the one place that has the Crab Rangoons that I crave!  I was not the biggest fan of the sushi.  But I liked everything else.  Standard food that you would expect at a buffet.  Some food had been sitting out for a bit but I saw the staff constantly refilling as fast as they could!

name: Tara Potter
text: We have been here many times it's usual  really  good but this time the food wasn't the greatest kinda old

name: Winifreidav Van winkle
text: Only large buffet in town.. Lots of food. Some made to ur liking. Busy on wkends an payday..something for everyone. Plenty of goodies.. Good for sm or big group.. Plenty of seating.. Table or booth. Bathrms need to be clean. Family friendly..

name: Seth C
text: The price is phenomenal for the amount of options you get. You can have a chef cook a noodle based dish of your design, there is endless sushi a good choice of traditional Chinese dishes and they also have a good selection of ice cream and dessert. You simply can not beat this place for the price and quality.

name: Emalina Steffen
text: Honestly, not the best place to eat, but it's a buffet. Go when its busy to get frehzfood otherwise youll get dry crusty food

name: Ryan Reiffenberger
text: Quality of service was great today. Some days it's not so great but we usually have a fairly satisfactory experience here. This is a popular place to get lunch, with To-Go boxes being priced by weight.

name: Brandy Mckay
text: Love coming here when in south Dakota. Good food

name: Jeff Beringer
text: Ate there for lunch yesterday.  Typical buffet.  Food is good....like most buffets, food could be hotter.  Some deserts seemed like they had been there for a while.  But remember, the food is good and I would go again.  Price is also good.

name: Alicia O
text:
Each and every time I come here the food is fresh and the service is good. The sushi bar never disappoints. The selection of ice cream/toppings for dessert is phenomenal. Prices are reasonable for everything they offer.

Edit: My last time visiting was somewhat disappointing. I feel like the food quality all around has declined. We received our waters promptly but they were never refilled. I didn't have water for half of my meal. The price did increase but it's still average for buffet price.

name: Thomas Duin
text: Always great food at a reasonable price and good service.

name: Angella Drummond
text: To me, food is always good, fresh. It's clean and the staff friendly

name: Hayden Dwire
text: Excellent food, great selection. Friendly staff and good service. $13 for a dinner buffet is not a bad price at all.

name: Danielle Schwantes
text: Has something for everyone, even family who doesn't like Chinese. Very wide variety

name: Susan Pellman
text: So much food to choose from! Need to come HUNGRY!  You have to try a little of everything. Good food

text: I am new in town, just in from Billings, Montana and ate here for the first time tonight. I was first impressed by the inside of the place. It's pretty neat with lots of really nice Chinese decorations as well as a fountain area with plants in it. The place is huge too and aside from the great furnishings and decorations, the buffet area is of equal proportion to the overall size of the place. Starting closest to the entry/ exit door there is a salad bar with both iceberg mix and a romaine mix. It also contains a few items like pasta salad. Next to this is a fresh fruit bar with oranges, bananas w/ strawberries, grapes, and 3 different Asian fruits: lychee, rambutan and one that looked kind of like an apricot but the waitress did not know the English word for it. All 3 are canned and taste faintly of rosewater but good if you like this kind of thing. Next, going toward the back of the place, is an ice cream bar with 6 or so flavors and several toppings. Next to this is a desert bar with cookies and little cakes. Next are the warm food bars and there are several of them with both Chinese and American dishes from the ubiquitous fried and white rice, lo mein, and several of the sticky chicken dishes such as General Tso's and one called "Hong Kong Chicken'" something I'd not seen before but it was ok if you like that kind of thing. I was impressed by the number of seafood items with everything from peel and eat ginger shrimp to a Cajun crawfish boil. There was a bar with all fried items like egg rolls and two of my favs, fried bananas and Chinese donuts. The American food bar had things like pizza, pasta and a pot roast type beef dish. I ignored all but the pot roast dish. It was pretty tasty. I've only mentioned a few of the items because there are too many to list and this is long already. I do want to mention the last two things though and that is the sushi bar and hibachi area. I am not a big sushi guy to begin with and what they have are a bunch of different rolls that are just really basic and I didn't bother with them. What is being called hibachi is also commonly called Mongolian BBQ. You get to choose from several raw vegetables and meats as well as rice and or noodles and there are several dry spices from salt and pepper to cumin, paprika and curry which I got. You then give whatever you've chosen to the cook and then tell him which sauce from a list of them he has and he cooks it right in front of you. It was really good and I look forward to getting it again next time I visit. I ate alone tonight but I really can't wait to take my kids. They have spent most of their lives in Billings and are going to be stunned by this place and I bet you will be too if you've never been here or a place like it!
